body:

| | | |
---
[](https://link.email.mikerogersforsenate.)
[]() Friend,
I’m not sending this through the normal campaign channels. [**This is too important, and honestly, too sensitive to risk leaking. I feel like I'm talking to you directly, one-on-one, in my office tonight.**](https://link.email.mikerogersforsenate.)

I just had a series of difficult conversations with D.C. leadership and, to be frank, they were distraught. They offered no good news, no solution for the tidal wave of dark money being poured against us. They have me dead to rights, Friend.
You and I both know this isn't about me—it's about whether we get President Trump's mandate through the Senate. If the liberals win this race, his agenda is blocked before it even starts.

I am coming to you now—humbling myself—because you are the only one I trust with this. My campaign cannot survive the deficit we're facing unless we hit our fundraising goal.

**[I’ve written a private note just for you, detailing exactly what I heard and why I'm so scared. Please, promise me you'll keep this strictly between us. If this note gets into the hands of the other side, Trump is finished.](https://link.email.mikerogersforsenate.)**

[READ MY URGENT NOTE](https://link.email.mikerogersforsenate.)
[]()
Your help today is the only way I can come back from this.
God Bless, Mike Rogers Republican Candidate for U.S. Senate

subject: Lauren Boebert continues her pattern of voting to harm her own district.
body:
| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://eileenforcolorado.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=400e8fa21dba23169b817268c&id=e32cbc430b&e=1c5f08419c)
| | | | |
---
| | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE****Date:** February 17, 2026**Contact:**[**Taylor Gillespie**](mailto:taylorg@eileenforcolorado.com)**,** 720-557-6185

**Lauren Boebert continues her pattern of voting to harm her own district**
_With prices high and families hurting, Lauren Bobert voted to keep tariffs in place, the cost of which is making life harder for Coloradans_
**Highlands Ranch, CO** – Again Lauren Boebert has voted to harm her own district. When given the opportunity to right the wrongs of tariffs, [Boebert voted](https://eileenforcolorado.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=400e8fa21dba23169b817268c&id=c4c1a5f5c4&e=1c5f08419c) to give up Congressional responsibility by keeping the tariffs that are harming Colorado's farmers and families in place. This was a move that even her Republican colleagues are admitting is a massive tax paid by American families. Republican **Representative Don Bacon** [was quoted as saying](https://eileenforcolorado.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=400e8fa21dba23169b817268c&id=f8bdddb6e6&e=1c5f08419c) _“American consumers pay the tariffs and thus it is a big tax.”_ Republican **Representative Jeff Hurd** of Colorado’s 3rd Congressional district [voted to repeal the tariffs on Canada](https://eileenforcolorado.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=400e8fa21dba23169b817268c&id=f0e2fcfbc7&e=1c5f08419c), but Boebert didn’t._“This is part of a broader pattern of decisions that don’t reflect what many people in this district need right now.“_ said **Retired Rear Admiral Eileen Laubacher**. _“Families are already feeling stretched. Supporting cuts to hospital funding, higher health insurance premiums, and policies that keep costs high makes it harder for hardworking Coloradans to get ahead. Leadership should be about listening and responding to the real concerns of the people you represent. This district deserves leaders who are focused on practical solutions that improve everyday life.”_ Eileen is not alone in her assessment of the harms these continued tariffs will bring. The [Yale Budget Lab has found](https://eileenforcolorado.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=400e8fa21dba23169b817268c&id=12eff07fc8&e=1c5f08419c) that these tariffs are creating a burden on the average Colorado family to the tune of $1,700 in additional costs each year. The[ US Chamber of Commerce has called](https://eileenforcolorado.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=400e8fa21dba23169b817268c&id=7ad6711d9e&e=1c5f08419c) on Congress to repeal these tariffs, writing that _“American families are facing thousands of dollars in higher prices as a result of these increased taxes. Small businesses, manufacturers, farmers, and ranchers are struggling with higher costs.”_ _“Colorado's 4th Congressional District has serious issues with its infrastructure, healthcare, water quality, and cost of living. Addressing any of those issues requires serious leadership.” said**Retired Rear Admiral Eileen Laubacher**. “Something that Boebert has demonstrated she is lacking.” _

Hi team, We are living through a moment when our most fundamental rights and our democracy are being tested. And not just lightly, but with the full force of the Trump administration. That might leave you wondering how, in the midst of all that, you should prioritize things like protecting our public lands. And here’s what I think: our public lands are the most physical representation of our democracy, our American birthright, our national identity, our American freedom. Being on our public lands is where you will come closest to that freedom. And those lands don’t care how thick your wallet is or how much is in your bank account — they belong to all of us equally. **That’s the way it should be.** No matter where your ancestors came from or when they got here, there’s a shared relationship to the land, the water, and wildlife. That’s not something you can put a price tag on. The effort and financial support we’re putting toward protecting our public lands is a reflection of you and what you care about — and it makes me proud to be a New Mexican. name: Roy Cooper
subject: They can’t scare me into backing down.

body:
I am ready for the fight.
#
Stop the chaos. Hold the line.
Peter, this is what elected leaders must do in the face of an administration that is intent on destroying our democracy for their own gain.
I have spent my career working for North Carolinians. Advocating for more resources for students in public schools and better pay for teachers. Building a clean energy economy to bring good-paying jobs to our communities while protecting this planet. Defending the right to cast a ballot and participate in our democracy. Fighting for Medicaid Expansion and winning it for the people. **I stand ready to do all this and more to deliver for the American people as the next Democratic Senator from North Carolina.**
_Far-right Republicans don’t tend to like that about me — and they don’t want me bringing this fight to Washington._
They’re attacking me in the media — President Trump has even done so from the stage at his rallies. They’re preparing to spend untold sums trying to take me down.
But I know how to win here. **And I will not back down.**
Because I have you on my side.
**[Peter, this is the most consequential Senate race of the midterms. It’s the seat that can take back the majority, break the GOP’s hold on Washington, and return power to the people. It won’t be easy, but we can succeed together. I’m humbly asking you to pitch in today and split a donation between our campaign and State Democrats Committee (any amount will help) to stand with me in the fight.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/100379?refcode=em20260217-10076&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10076%2E614464%2EFSIeLY)**

I couldn’t do this without you. Thank you.
Roy

subject: The 2026 Primary Election Has Been Moved Up
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Vote Bolick
body:
Can you help us qualify for the ballot? | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/bolickforarizona/the-2026-primary-election-has-been-moved-up?e=a7ab36849c)
---
|
---
| | Dear Friend:

You may have heard, the Arizona mid-term election date was moved up from August 4th to July 21st. Every candidate across our state running for office just lost two weeks to collect their nomination petition signatures to qualify for the primary election so because the county election administrators across the state requested the August primary be moved up by two weeks to better comply with federal deadlines, helping ensure our military serving overseas would receive their ballots in a timely manner.

Could you please go online and sign my online nomination petition at [https://go.azsos.gov/z9xl](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=4c3f409f15&e=a7ab36849c) ?
**Your online signature makes a huge difference. **
Just use your driver’s license or voter registration card to confirm your identity. It will take less than 90 seconds to sign my secure nomination petition at [https://go.azsos.gov/z9xl](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=ceafccc10f&e=a7ab36849c "E-Qual Petition Page")

Your digital signature saves us time, money, and helps keep our district strong.

Thank you for your continued support!
— Shawnna

P.S. If you have already signed our online nomination petition, **THANK YOU!**

Texas Republican attorneys general candidates sparred on the debate stage Tuesday night, taking jabs at their opponents seeking to succeed Ken Paxton. During the attorneys general debate hosted by Blaze Media's Allie Beth Stuckey, candidates like Republican congressman Chip Roy and attorney Aaron Reitz took aim at their competitors' track records and legal experience. Also participating in what Stuckey termed, the "only debate to feature all four Republican candidates," were state senators Mayes Middleton and Joan Huffman.'Don't be fooled by the kind of Republican that says, 'It can't be done.''Middleton took a blow from Reitz after addressing the topic of gambling and sports betting, noting that it is both unconstitutional and illegal in the state of Texas.

| Friends,
🚨 Today is the LAST DAY to properly notice your caucus!🚨
Per Convention Rules, caucuses must be held by the last day of this month, and with the required 10-day notice, today is your final opportunity to get it officially on the books.
Don't let your town or ward go unrepresented at Convention!

## 📣 Step 1: Send Your Notice TODAY
Your caucus notice must go out at least 10 days prior via U.S. Mail, email, text message, or any combination of these, to:
* All members and associate members of your ward or town
* The Party Chair
* Both State Committee members representing your ward or town

AND don't forget -- your caucus must also be entered into the MassGOP caucus portal at least 10 days in advance too: [https://massgop.com/events/community/add](https://qgzxgy5ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001M-MSK-XD7MaoCOGAX20ix58R_1jmVn_dggx-lkqqCu-1DVSF7FPG2ZCaxUFGReq0vF1S493hEFi1dS-MuOmdmU_xzmmubXrpylWs35B2u5pwzGGRfZBqo7Cfo1rdyn84KeH-wGTbT0pd8H1u2dQUCysYcJUew1jErh7pMSLP72Y3f0hyUAJ3qQ==&c=lXBLsX9UN3JZJslxH9flxXdQj5eq7xcXXuE6flsRg1arpyRZ9MX0gw==&ch=-6g7kEbBrZ2avJfDirGme5Cz27nTueLrCTKIBm-cNjtE7GxYsxCeXw==)

---
| [SUBMIT YOUR CAUCUS NOTICE](https://qgzxgy5ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001M-MSK-XD7MaoCOGAX20ix58R_1jmVn_dggx-lkqqCu-1DVSF7FPG2ZCaxUFGReq0vF1S493hEFi1dS-MuOmdmU_xzmmubXrpylWs35B2u5pwzGGRfZBqo7Cfo1rdyn84KeH-wGTbT0pd8H1u2dQUCysYcJUew1jErh7pMSLP72bxDPlxhQFY6g==&c=lXBLsX9UN3JZJslxH9flxXdQj5eq7xcXXuE6flsRg1arpyRZ9MX0gw==&ch=-6g7kEbBrZ2avJfDirGme5Cz27nTueLrCTKIBm-cNjtE7GxYsxCeXw==)
---
## 🗳 Step 2: Hold Your Caucus
Here's what to remember:
* Delegates are elected by majority vote of those present
* Any eligible resident of the ward or town may be elected
* No proxy voting allowed
* A person does not need to attend to be elected as a delegate

## 📄 Step 3: Report Your Delegates
After your caucus, delegate information must be submitted within 10 days through the reporting portal: [https://massgop.com/massgop-convention-2026-delegate-report/](https://qgzxgy5ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001M-MSK-XD7MaoCOGAX20ix58R_1jmVn_dggx-lkqqCu-1DVSF7FPG2ZCaxUFGReq0ezlogPpsvwsbjK77c2L2ZY5T5fiLW6B25z_wM3dWrjvK8TxeopL2FrDYl4kLMSbalhDmLgpZ6g3jK-Hyry1d_ySi52oyowGgMjsuBpqt_mcozugb347FG3yPaA58gRL0odZ8dhDwoK-RrveepLc9aQ==&c=lXBLsX9UN3JZJslxH9flxXdQj5eq7xcXXuE6flsRg1arpyRZ9MX0gw==&ch=-6g7kEbBrZ2avJfDirGme5Cz27nTueLrCTKIBm-cNjtE7GxYsxCeXw==) Password: Mass$GOP2026!
---
| [REPORT YOUR DELEGATES AFTER THE CAUCUS](https://qgzxgy5ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001M-MSK-XD7MaoCOGAX20ix58R_1jmVn_dggx-lkqqCu-1DVSF7FPG2ZCaxUFGReq0ezlogPpsvwsbjK77c2L2ZY5T5fiLW6B25z_wM3dWrjvK8TxeopL2FrDYl4kLMSbalhDmLgpZ6g3jK-Hyry1d_ySi52oyowGgMjsuBpqt_mcozugb347FG3yPaA58gRL0aiXrlx5B-vdCNbwb1lY7jA==&c=lXBLsX9UN3JZJslxH9flxXdQj5eq7xcXXuE6flsRg1arpyRZ9MX0gw==&ch=-6g7kEbBrZ2avJfDirGme5Cz27nTueLrCTKIBm-cNjtE7GxYsxCeXw==)

## 💳 Step 4: Pay the Delegate Fee
Each delegate must submit the $150 Delegate Fee:
* Pay online: [https://secure.winred.com/massachusetts-gop/2026delegatefee](https://qgzxgy5ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001M-MSK-XD7MaoCOGAX20ix58R_1jmVn_dggx-lkqqCu-1DVSF7FPG2ZCaxUFGReq042T8SBaJ6e0pbWa-N8TYXeb4dThuTOpEVpzeNK-SDj5sc7NZyIll6ANeo9g5EC2cPpHRLtdqmQNxmSUS_t4JOa6UXwKspFMkGgBNQoOPb7mBZXIcH8VVh71tokjkCDA6RvKuc4DHlKiJaQfizppwew==&c=lXBLsX9UN3JZJslxH9flxXdQj5eq7xcXXuE6flsRg1arpyRZ9MX0gw==&ch=-6g7kEbBrZ2avJfDirGme5Cz27nTueLrCTKIBm-cNjtE7GxYsxCeXw==)

| A lot has happened since that day in 2021.
I testified before Congress about what really happened. I spoke truth to power while some of the same people I protected tried to rewrite history and pretend it was just a "normal tourist visit."
I've endured relentless attacks from Trump and his MAGA supporters. They've called me every name in the book. They've threatened my family. They've threatened me.
But I still believe that we must stand up for what's right.
Now, Donald Trump is back in the White House with unchecked power.
His ICE agents are terrorizing communities with masks and military weapons -- just like his insurrectionists did on January 6th. The only difference is that now they're being paid with your tax dollars.
His MAGA enablers in Congress are letting him treat the Constitution like it's optional. They're ignoring subpoenas. They're refusing oversight. They're acting like Trump is a king instead of a president.
And I'm not going to sit back and let it happen.
That's why I'm running for Congress, Peter.
Because my oath to protect and defend the Constitution didn't end on January 6th. It will never end.
Our country has lived through challenging periods before. We've overcome, persevered, and moved toward a more perfect union. We're in the middle of another fight for our country right now.
I still have faith that good can prevail over evil and that we can overcome these hard times. What is right still matters here... but only if we make it matter.
I'm ready to continue this fight in Congress. I know Trump and his MAGA machine inside and out. I've faced them before. I stood strong when it mattered most.

Harry Dunn Democrat for Congress in Maryland's 5th District

## Rev. Jesse Jackson Dies at 84
The Rev. Jesse Jackson, the civil rights leader who [marched alongside Martin Luther King Jr.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD1u6zAQBk8jdRTI1R9fweI16pw2pbAml9Y6a9EgCSm-feBcIfUHfIOZz8t6QRbebx_4IFdjWnc6i1CtlFePwjHlnREPFNz9RiGJYF5Bw6Q0KGPXgCyvdWiDi0RAfUvOzLMZDMzj2G7OgA7_dAza-sGAueLcA1lrx3EKetLUsnu_aTDWGD2OfQfmqufeQ5hi9KOmZtAUuKbc3RPvdaMor3RQ7nx6tOK2Wp-l6f83sDSwnOfZxfT9tnjvDSzPJFzZlwaWO5VC6o7-q6RdBcKgPB8sKvNtq0UJYaCs7NBmF54ni3CZ5mbQtwey_PLqnyIdDn4CAAD__2q7e9s) and twice ran for president, died Tuesday morning surrounded by his family in Chicago. He was 84. Jackson had been [hospitalized in recent months](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2u5CAQhE-DMyxo8M8EBJs4e5tuaPVAY_csY54A2Zrbr7xXeFlJJVXp-_58rV_IiY_tN77JtZjXg66aqDUqq8fEMZeDEU9MePidQk4JywoKRqlA6nkNyOmz2i64SARkOnJ6mrTVMA1Dtztj7PwYDI3aj36wD23jc4Jg8BFnb3Du2N1rCvSstRoG04N-qsl4CGOMflAkrKLALZf-lfloO8X0ySeV3ud3l9ze2ncV5peARcByXVfvn_WmuHsByx0FLC-qleQL_d-aDxmYqsSN5Gyl55OTLLztrcpEGKgIWLriwvfFKXEdJ2HV9kZO_y_bjzydDv4FAAD__8DPfHM) for progressive supranuclear palsy, a degenerative neurological disorder. He also publicly revealed he'd been diagnosed with Parkinson's disease in 2017. A protégé of King's, Jackson founded the Rainbow PUSH Coalition and became one of the most prominent and controversial voices in the American civil rights movement for over five decades. President Trump called him _"a good man, with lots of personality, grit, and 'street smarts.'"_

body:

Dear Friend,
I am running for Congress because I believe Colorado's Third Congressional District deserves strong, consistent leadership that supports President Trump's agenda and puts America First.
Recently, President Trump made it clear that Republicans who fail to stand firm on trade and economic strength will be held accountable. His warning came after a key vote on tariff measures involving Canada -- a vote that was about protecting American industry, leverage in trade negotiations, and standing up for American workers.
Congressman Jeff Hurd was one of just six Republicans who voted against President Trump's tariff measures.
For many conservatives, that vote was not just about trade policy. It was about whether our leaders will stand with an America First economic agenda or continue policies that weaken our negotiating position and disadvantage American producers.
Unfortunately, that vote is not an isolated example.
Congressman Hurd's record shows a pattern of decisions that many voters in our district have raised serious concerns about.
He voted in favor of continuing Obamacare-related subsidies, further entrenching a federal healthcare system that expands government control and increases long-term taxpayer burdens.
He supported funding measures that allow federal dollars to flow to hospitals that perform abortions and gender-transition procedures involving minors -- an issue that deeply concerns parents and families across our district.
He voted not to support censure efforts related to Representative Ilhan Omar following controversial remarks about conservative activist Charlie Kirk that many Americans found offensive.
Jeff Hurd is also worked with far left Senators Michael Bennet and John Hickenlooper on the GORP Act, legislation that would expand federal control on more than 700,000 acres of Colorado public land, negatively impacting ranching, energy resources, and timber.
These votes are public record. They reflect priorities and direction. Jeff Hurd is not the conservative he portrays himself to be.
My priorities are straightforward:
I support President Trump's America First agenda.
I believe children deserve protection -- not experimentation.
I believe healthcare decisions should be centered on families, not Washington bureaucrats.
I believe America should negotiate from strength and protect our workers and producers through fair trade enforcement.
Representation isn't about party labels -- it's about conviction and accountability.
I will defend and uphold these priorities and more when elected as your congresswoman.
This campaign is about restoring principled, accountable representation to Colorado's Third District and ensuring our voice in Congress reflects the values of the people who live here -- not the pressures of Washington.

---

clean_body: Hurd voted with Democrats | | | | | == | | Dear Friend, I am running for Congress because I believe Colorado's Third Congressional District deserves strong, consistent leadership that supports President Trump's agenda and puts America First. Recently, President Trump made it clear that Republicans who fail to stand firm on trade and economic strength will be held accountable. His warning came after a key vote on tariff measures involving Canada -- a vote that was about protecting American industry, leverage in trade negotiations, and standing up for American workers. Congressman Jeff Hurd was one of just six Republicans who voted against President Trump's tariff measures. For many conservatives, that vote was not just about trade policy. It was about whether our leaders will stand with an America First economic agenda or continue policies that weaken our negotiating position and disadvantage American producers. Unfortunately, that vote is not an isolated example. Congressman Hurd's record shows a pattern of decisions that many voters in our district have raised serious concerns about. He voted in favor of continuing Obamacare-related subsidies, further entrenching a federal healthcare system that expands government control and increases long-term taxpayer burdens. He supported funding measures that allow federal dollars to flow to hospitals that perform abortions and gender-transition procedures involving minors -- an issue that deeply concerns parents and families across our district. He voted not to support censure efforts related to Representative Ilhan Omar following controversial remarks about conservative activist Charlie Kirk that many Americans found offensive. Jeff Hurd is also worked with far left Senators Michael Bennet and John Hickenlooper on the GORP Act, legislation that would expand federal control on more than 700,000 acres of Colorado public land, negatively impacting ranching, energy resources, and timber. These votes are public record. They reflect priorities and direction. Jeff Hurd is not the conservative he portrays himself to be. My priorities are straightforward: I support President Trump's America First agenda. I believe children deserve protection -- not experimentation. I believe healthcare decisions should be centered on families, not Washington bureaucrats. I believe America should negotiate from strength and protect our workers and producers through fair trade enforcement. Representation isn't about party labels -- it's about conviction and accountability. I will defend and uphold these priorities and more when elected as your congresswoman. This campaign is about restoring principled, accountable representation to Colorado's Third District and ensuring our voice in Congress reflects the values of the people who live here -- not the pressures of Washington. | == Your support--whether it's $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can give--will help us finish the year strong and head into 2026 with momentum, confidence, and a campaign ready to win. We are almost there. Together, we can do this. ## Warehouse Owner Declines Sale to Feds
A million-square-foot warehouse off I-20 and I-45 in Hutchins will not be turned into an ICE detention center, [according to](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L_upCAUxfGnwY4JXFG0oNjGbrbd0jBw0ZsgGGD--Pab2WSf4Fef5JuTz5_7ercUKW2_7YGmfUJeE75rxNawrOQwWEeR2nVGm2qiD3qXS1pBwMgFcDmt3lK8VtV58xB-lh0aqbVUcpRi6HbjVC9mpyentPDg1ahVUBDmgL3urR07Mt-YADlJEFL1N_sYJutwchiGYdaCKYGeWi63tmPDj60hXvmF5eby0UWzt3ZW1v9isDBYnE3-qp5K-84Mlm-dwSKAwSI1g2V_NrdTqvxtC-75WZGnzGNOGxZOiZ_RXjzkwskhP3Cz3GPD1Cgn_p-DwdIV4883xUh11EyJ7bAU_11qP4N8GfgbAAD__-SeiFU) a Monday statement from the California-based company that owns the property. ICE reportedly intended to convert the warehouse into a 9,500-bed detention center for illegal immigrants awaiting deportation, causing alarm among some residents in the Dallas County town. The agency is planning [four new detention centers](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOozAQhJ_GdEb2gjEULq6hy7VXIsdewkqOjcwmJG9_SqT_Cf5qipE-zXz_LsvFU6J8--vv6Pi1liXjeSRkxrpQwNUHSsTvPfl8ZHphDKXmBRQMUoHU4xI9pffSN9FdVZx0g05bq3s9aGWazZnVGwhxHYbe-wnQXIPt-jFaNACrsQ25D0yBHjUo3Xetv5rRBxwDrsZMVoleYSQuteUNGV_-WNO7PLG2odyb5Dbm_RDdHwGzgPk8zzZsteRPK2DeSyKmcAiYfWUKCQXMX4o8fcWtPA6UubDkIvlR8ycpoPw5LkF3xupxavdtb6qL-0kp0TFY0avb3VP6zuDfyXs6-B8AAP__AMyFbQ) in Texas and has already acquired sites in El Paso and San Antonio. "_God answered our prayers_ ," said Mayor Mario Vasquez, who had told Majestic Realty Co. that turning the warehouse into a detention facility would "devastate" the community. "_The public pressure, I think, ultimately led to this happening_ ," [said Kim Verriere](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykULGSrSAU-xrtcAAVtaB4jd197ZYOwuF6drngwNmr_v2O-wvbZTJJJsnHY3kYDBif_80LNJ0-LRGOEoAI8oIWvLEYkK49mFginuBsynGRXCrGJRPj4gyGa-lqp1fuJlGDFsMgOqEE7-tNS9WC4D1XrVrHFlQ7SWGgHcwE3gmpatR3GJdiFJKLrm3M2o_GwmjB9_008Krj4JBSbmgDgtMUH670htzY9KqD3oj2UrX_KjlXcj6Oo_Hp7O4Zt6CS8w0rOd_WWNgakv1iaIE5IIiEKTILkSCzYgKw7ZvshrEw429uz2mHTBdLR4TMMnyCpcKS95DrrN1-YAhY1FB1_PkyGH5b0d--fGv5EwAA__8kFoyP) of the Clergy League for Emergency Action and Response. The federal government could still acquire the property [through eminent domain](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOgzAQRL_GdEZeYxtTuLiGLtdeiZZlHSw5EIETkr8_Eem-4OrRPM2bn8twwZTTcv3GG4fyiuuw8LFnLoW3IRFHpJRTed8zLvuSXjzRui2DVtpJpSX4YcKU34OppjCqqYOKA7QtGHCgbDUHbBl5dEYZpxSzidTxCEpbAGXH1lUpnDClwYNWYJoaR-uR2BNHa7tWCaN4SmXd6jJz4RfuMb_XJ281rbcqh7mU-y6aL6F7ofvjOOojIp6h0D1uJVFmofvTS-g-r4RZ6H5-FJrTsssPUSZi-ecqD9x4Xh_7WdO-lQDEBptOOhuNNEBWjqMnSdFiJPQNOF9tYbofKee0u1YYdb1hyp-F5X-_PoP-DQAA__-tiYuX), but has not confirmed plans for a detention center in Hutchins.
## Paxton Targets EPIC City Again in Latest Suit
Attorney General Ken Paxton [filed another lawsuit](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGuozAQBdCvMd1EtgPEFC7S0L2tVnolcuxxGK2xWTwJ5O9XvF_YbqSRju6931_Tl6NE-fnLLWj5iGXKuNeEzLhN5DE6T4n4syaXa6YDgy9bnrTUPUgNykzBUfpMbRPsQ4ZBNWjV7aZa1SvZNbNVXsZHP_TRG9TXznXGm75z6JWWvTe-IXtiUiujtFTt9eIenXEejcfYdcNNilZiIC7bhWdkPFyN6VPeuF18WZpkZ-a1iutd6FHocd_3y1Lz-RN6xAyvKvR4lhJ6_LndE_5ghtUdXDJESljB5cIzbpDcXl_EcPIQIO4Q8I2prAtmBiYMwAVwJQ9LqX9feHob3O_qm38PbbPZsO6UEtX-Jlr5XByln5j8f-O-rf4XAAD__y7lkM4) related to the planned Muslim-centric development previously known as EPIC City in North Texas, accusing its backers of actions "that appear designed to evade state oversight." According to the lawsuit, Double R Municipal Utility District No. 2A of Hunt and Collin Counties was expanded to include more than 400 acres of the development during a September board meeting [held at a remote location](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkb2OpDAQhJ_GZD2ye_kNCC4h20svRMZudlrX2Ag3w8zbn2bDSzetkj7pq_rzOX96Fk5fv_1Goz7XPCe6ipAqHTMHWn1gYX3t4lNJ_KQY8pFmtNiCRXD9HD3La66rOC42Dq6i0XWdq13rbFPdx9WhxzVSQNvG2rVx6Ho_LItrcbHO1xWPb5hF1zu0rv64-aXpfaA-0No0Q2dNbSmy5uOmd1J6-rLKKz_ouIW8VTLeVfdiPn4ZnAxO13XdrtX7d2lw8odyEDI4vb0MTpKDF4NTyCKcIOQz6cvg9JcS7P6pOUE5qUDM5yIEB5z6PQBELnpwUFCmCNtZhDcIlN4hRHqQ5H2jpPA_GfsObIwUFuzADe0A9bog9F1oIA5LH3uqcfWhOsa4XyzCpe1Mbb82z_LtqD975jHivwAAAP__Li2lZg) identified only by GPS coordinates. Ahead of the vote to expand the district, all of the board members resigned and were immediately replaced. The five new board members don't own land within the district and aren't registered to vote there, making them ineligible for appointment, according to the lawsuit. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

What if the world found out that a promising cancer therapy was discovered? Not only that it existed, but also that it was free and painless for the patient. Research suggests that simply not eating (fasting) for a specific and planned timeframe, may be this therapy.
Hippocrates, the father of medicine, often used caloric restriction, or fasting, as his method of healing patients. This quote, packed in wisdom, is attributed to the legendary Greek physician: "To eat when you are sick, is to feed your illness." It seems that even around 400 BCE this concept was understood.
Fasting has been used as a religious mechanism for millennia to gain mental focus and clarity. Most cultures discovered its anti-inflammatory and healing benefits along the way. In our modern era, it's only in the past decade that we've started unraveling the process of how fasting affects our metabolic and cellular health.

The quest for longevity and health has driven scientific exploration into various avenues, with one of the latest frontiers being the study of senescent cells. These cells, often referred to as "zombie cells," are a key player in the aging process and age-related diseases. In developed countries, cancer is either the main cause of death or second only to cardiovascular disease. In 2020, an estimated 19.3 million new cancer cases and almost 10 million cancer deaths occurred worldwide. (Trends in Cancer, Vol. 9, Issue 3, March 2023, Pages 212-222).
Senescent cells are cells that have lost their ability to divide and proliferate, yet they remain metabolically active. These cells resist apoptosis (programmed cell death) and, as they age, gain size and enlarge their nuclei. The accumulation of these zombie cells contributes to the aging process and the development of age-related diseases. They secrete a range of molecules which can induce chronic inflammation and disrupt the surrounding tissues' functionality. This phenomenon has been linked to various conditions, including cancer, cardiovascular disease, and neurodegenerative disorders.
Fasting or Caloric Restriction (CR) to the rescue. When we stop intaking glucose, the weakest or most sugar dependent cells die first. Fasting also supercharges your immune system, increases hormone production, and boosts the production of healthy stem cells, promoting cellular health and repair.
One of the mechanisms through which fasting combats senescent cells is called autophagy, which involves the degradation and recycling of damaged components, including organelles and proteins. During periods of fasting, when energy sources are scarce, cells initiate autophagy to break down unnecessary or dysfunctional components, rejuvenating themselves in the process.
Fasting has also been shown to reduce glucose levels in the blood, which makes it difficult for cancers to grow. Cancer cells consume glucose at a much higher level than normal cells do.
During fasting periods, the body exhausts its immediate glucose reserves and starts utilizing stored fats for energy. This metabolic shift triggers various cellular responses that lead to the removal of senescent cells.
The synergy between cutting-edge research and ancient dietary practices holds the promise to a healthier, longer life. In this article we have summarized some recent scientific breakthroughs in the benefits of fasting as it relates to reducing the risk of disease. Fasting also improves gut health, regulates hormones, resets the body, detoxifies organs, enhances cognitive function, helps with mindfulness, and promotes weight loss.
Through our nutrition company at FastEatLive.com, we have helped hundreds of clients integrate "fasting" into their social and active lifestyles. We also guide our community on best fuel choices for their bodies. Reach out via our website or Instagram (@fasteatlive) to learn how you can get connected.
We also suggest before embarking on your own fasting regimen, that you consult with healthcare professionals, especially for those with existing medical conditions. ◆
For further health coaching on this topic and more, contact us at FastEatLive.com

name: The Editors at Broad + Liberty
subject: Sheriff Bilal makes Philadelphia law enforcement a global laughingstock
body:
News + editorial | Broad + Liberty Weekly Reads | | | |
---
| | | Good morning, and welcome to _Broad + Liberty_ 's Wednesday Weekly Reads!

As always, to stay up to date on late-breaking stories and analysis, [subscribe to our daily email list](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=79747e29a2&e=b7b3eddce2) and get the best of _Broad + Liberty_ delivered straight to your inbox.
---
|
---
|
# 1\. ** [Rochelle Bilal makes Philadelphia law enforcement a global laughingstock](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=d1a7e1d884&e=b7b3eddce2)**
# _By Ben Mannes_
Philadelphia Sheriff Rochelle Bilal is facing intensifying backlash after an unprofessional recruitment video featuring her office’s costly mascot, “Deputy Sheriff Justice,” went viral for all the wrong reasons. The incident compounds criticism sparked by her recent remarks labeling federal Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents “made-up, fake, wannabe law enforcement.” Viewers have mocked the tone and imagery of the ad, with posts in police and corrections groups attaching captions such as “please tell me this isn’t real” as the clip spread far beyond Philadelphia. Separate print and transit ads that surfaced at the same time feature stern‐slogan recruitment messaging paired with photos of deputies who appear older or physically out of shape, further fueling questions inside the law‐enforcement community about the office’s standards and public image. **Why It Matters.** With Bilal’s recruitment video now circulating globally among law‐enforcement circles alongside her “fake law enforcement” comments about ICE, questions are mounting over whether federal or state prosecutors will move beyond audits and letters to pursue charges related to alleged waste, fraud, or mismanagement in the Sheriff’s Office. Just as pointed are questions for Philadelphia’s political establishment: why party power brokers and city leaders have allowed one of its most controversial elected law‐enforcement officials to remain in place, even as critics say her stewardship has turned an obscure courthouse agency into a recurring embarrassment on a national stage. [_Continue Reading_](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=cd277e8b0f&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
|
---
|
# 2\. **[Rubio wants to make America and Europe united — and great again](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=f0836f4577&e=b7b3eddce2)**

_By Guy Ciarrocchi_ Secretary of State Marco Rubio seized the opportunity of the 62nd Munich Conference not merely to give another foreign policy speech, but to[ _set forth both a vision and call to action_](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=22146b4c90&e=b7b3eddce2) for America and our European allies to seek greatness built on Western civilization and our shared cultures and values — not merely to defend our history, but to confront the future without fear. His 22-minute speech sets forth America’s vision, inviting our allies — on whose shoulders America stands — to chart this course together. But America will stand alone if we must. **Why It Matters.** Rubio issues the call to action to the European leaders — inviting, if not imploring them, to defend themselves and join us in the possibilities of what comes next. _“Our predecessors recognized that decline was a choice, and it was a choice they refused to make...We want allies who can defend themselves so that no adversary will ever be tempted to test our collective strength..._ _For we in America have no interest in being polite and orderly caretakers of the West’s managed decline...What we want is a reinvigorated alliance that recognizes that what has ailed our societies is not just a set of bad policies but a malaise of hopelessness and complacency...And the only fear we have is the fear of the shame of not leaving our nations prouder, stronger, and wealthier for our children. _ _And I am here today to leave it clear that America is charting the path for a new century of prosperity, and that once again we want to do it together with you, our cherished allies and our oldest friends.”_ [_Continue Reading_](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=992aaed127&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
|
---
|
# 3\. Lightning Round
* [_From the Editors: Separation of powers keeps us free_](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=470b21fe59&e=b7b3eddce2)
* [_Christine Flowers: Antisemitism again, this time from Religious Liberty Commission member_](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=bb486e7008&e=b7b3eddce2)
* [_Thom Nickels: It could have been worse_](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=a96bd906fe&e=b7b3eddce2)
* [_Paul Davis: Carjacker sentenced to prison for two armed carjackings days apart_](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=1e9e1f319e&e=b7b3eddce2)
* [_Voices of Americans group launches new Save Our Girls ad campaign_](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=e53db8454e&e=b7b3eddce2)
* [_Gerard J. St. John: Pigpen and the Philadelphia Lawyer_](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=3cf35f4c04&e=b7b3eddce2)
* [_Patricia Rooney: Pennsylvania Republicans should pass redistricting reform while they still can_](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=0c2deadb5b&e=b7b3eddce2)

---
|
---
|
# 4\. What we're reading
America has always led the way on industrial and technological innovation. So why are we now falling behind on the race to make electric cars and trucks that people actually want to drive? [_Michael Dunne writes about it this week_](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=6c8d73772f&e=b7b3eddce2) for our friends at _The Free Press —_ check it out and decide for yourself whether America needs to lead on electric vehicles or whether they’re a niche market that’s been overhyped by environmentalists.

| Republican Friends,
We hope you'll join us on Thursday, March 5, 2026, for the Nebraska Republican Party's annual Senators Recognition Dinner--Red Wave Rising at the Lincoln Station Grand Ballroom in Lincoln.
This evening is about honoring our Republican state senators -- the men and women who are fighting every day to advance conservative policy and protect Nebraska values. Nearly our entire Republican legislative caucus will be in attendance as we publicly recognize their leadership, service, and commitment to our state.
This is one of the most meaningful nights of the year for Nebraska Republicans--a time to come together, recognize strong conservative leadership, and celebrate the work being done on behalf of our state.
With special guest comedian Tom Shillue, our evening will be memorable and entertaining. Join us for laughter and light-hearted fun as we celebrate our Republican Senators.
Those with VIP reception access, will join us in special recognition of the Senators serving their last term and whose leadership has and is shaping Nebraska's future.
In addition to recognizing our current Senators, we are proud to present:
Lifetime Achievement Award Honorable Donald Stenberg
Outstanding Legacy Statesman Award Honorable Carol McBride Pirsch
Event Schedule VIP Reception: 5:30 - 6:30 PM Dinner & Program: 6:30 - 9:00 PM

Hello Patriot,
If we want our communities -- and our country -- to change for the better, it starts with us. Not someday. Not someone else. Us -- showing up, getting active, and standing together.
We're building a strong, action-driven volunteer team dedicated to supporting America-First values right here in our neighborhoods. Whether you have a few hours a month or want to be on the front lines of grassroots engagement, there's a place for you to serve.

---
Here are the ways you can jump in:
🚛 Trailer Team Help move billboard trailers at community events, rallies, and outreach opportunities. Drive the billboard around major events for maximum visibility! Perfect for volunteers comfortable with driving and logistics support. We use rental trucks so you do not need to use your own vehicle.
🇺🇸 Street Team - Events & Sporting Events Be visible, positive, and energetic at local events -- showing community pride, connecting with people, and representing our shared values. Check out the [Campaign store](https://5vev59hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010CdNp6B43QmTDQWjLdgN0DnL1kbfibxMzPEPGn3zmCyf5_MhujH-M-8AxyLkpa_1MskiyjdJQt1pNS0x2N0F2Ws_5EfObzFedpv0eY0O2-fIABO8h0SvgPomlPPQgoLh3j57n2ymJ3fnexS_bTPLYEYhSqbPENMGKWUwUnkb7xcQ2h5gnh7SLK0Y2_OvOh2eQSg_8Kcd2Zc_dqXEZtI61w==&c=RLYV6f5spaDs-e_FIMJzic-y-28yt_FrPpqkJfkrWVYVa6XsfHE4RA==&ch=SptTKoUig9K-d5gzxvFWgVJYjkBc6e7MgCbVMft4CFF4YFJjBdpCDA==)[ ](https://5vev59hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010CdNp6B43QmTDQWjLdgN0DnL1kbfibxMzPEPGn3zmCyf5_MhujH-M-8AxyLkpa_1MskiyjdJQt1pNS0x2N0F2Ws_5EfObzFedpv0eY0O2-fIABO8h0SvgPomlPPQgoLh3j57n2ymJ3fnexS_bTPLYEYhSqbPENMGKWUwUnkb7xcQ2h5gnh7SLK0Y2_OvOh2eM7icaEZGGve4XEhmLts1-g==&c=RLYV6f5spaDs-e_FIMJzic-y-28yt_FrPpqkJfkrWVYVa6XsfHE4RA==&ch=SptTKoUig9K-d5gzxvFWgVJYjkBc6e7MgCbVMft4CFF4YFJjBdpCDA==)for merch!

Friend —
My name is Shaun Finnie, and I’m running for Congress to lower costs, protect affordable health care, and put working families ahead of special interests.
But I’m also running because we have to flip the House in 2026 — and that starts by firing Dan Crenshaw.
This race will be decisive.

That’s why we just launched our first ad of the cycle — not as an end goal, but as a signal: this campaign is real, competitive, and built to win.

clean_body: | | | BREAKING: Grand Jury Rebuffs Justice Dept. Attempt to Indict 6 Democrats in Congress Friend, this is outrageous. Trump’s Justice Department prosecutors just tried (and failed) to indict me and five of my colleagues for stating the law in a way they didn’t like. No one can force our troops to follow illegal orders, and the oath to the Constitution is sacred. In response? A group of regular Americans sitting on a grand jury looked at this and said:No. This is not a crime. That’s because Americans know and believe that our Constitution is not a polite suggestion to those in power—we take an oath to support and defend the Constitution, and that is bigger than any weak man or his even weaker enablers. This was an abuse of power, and Americans shut it down. ** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately. Back in November, several of my colleagues and I released a video reaffirming a basic constitutional truth: the oath to the Constitution comes above all. No service member is required to follow an illegal order. Full stop. Trump’s response? He tried to bully and intimidate us into silence. He went so far as to have his allies at the Justice Department push for criminal charges against members of Congress for saying things he didn’t like. Donald Trump and his administration tried to intimidate us. Indict us. But a group of everyday Americans sitting on that grand jury looked at this case and shut it down. That almost never happens. Prosecutors almost always get the indictments they ask for. The fact that American citizens rejected this tells you everything—they could see what this really was: an abuse of power meant to punish people for standing up for the Constitution. Friend, even in this moment of intimidation and chaos, ordinary Americans still recognize the difference between the rule of law and raw political revenge. I first swore an oath to the Constitution as a 17-year-old at the Naval Academy. I took that oath again when I was elected to represent Western Pennsylvania in Congress. That oath is sacred. It’s lifelong. It doesn’t expire. And it doesn’t bend to threats or tantrums from a would-be strongman. America isn’t about loyalty to one man, it’s about loyalty to the Constitution. Defending that is something I will never shy away from. ** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately. body:
This phrase makes my head explode.

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125625731/602397244/510768709?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTIzMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MDUwZGVlMC1kYjBjLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yxIJuDdH4vFmHRMqzWlA7FTmGfXs1y__hl6aXcyNMTw=) I want to be real clear about this. I do not care for the term “moral victory.” You know why? Because Democrats have settled for too many moral victories in recent years — but secured too few actual wins. body:
One year ago, Trump and Musk shut down USAID

|
---

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125626514/602399912/1988672456?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_USAID_260218_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNTRmN2U5My1kYzBjLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sxxmYFL0FMzPjcxtjwqTQg2DlNwG6Z-ECTZowUMdcj4=) Derek, this month marks a grim milestone – one year ago, Donald Trump and Elon Musk shut down the United States Agency for International Development, or USAID.

I want to talk about why this has been so bad for both the United States and the world, and [_**why I’m asking for your help.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125626515/602399913/1988672456?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_USAID_260218_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNTRmN2U5My1kYzBjLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sxxmYFL0FMzPjcxtjwqTQg2DlNwG6Z-ECTZowUMdcj4=)

When Trump and his allies went after USAID, they said they were cutting "foreign aid." What they _actually_ did was take aim at programs that fight pandemics, feed hungry kids, and grow economies. And the damage doesn't stop at our borders. Gutting USAID is dangerous for Americans right here at home.

**The truth is, USAID was one of the smartest investments America made in its own security and prosperity – and it’s why I fought like hell to protect it.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125626516/602399914/1988672456?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_USAID_260218_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNTRmN2U5My1kYzBjLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sxxmYFL0FMzPjcxtjwqTQg2DlNwG6Z-ECTZowUMdcj4=) USAID contracts supported American farmers who feed the world, and keep our children healthy. It stopped pandemics before they arrived at our shores. It created over 10,000 American jobs at home and overseas – including many right here in Virginia. And USAID helped us counter foreign powers like China and Russia that are seeking to expand their global influence and undermine the United States' global leadership.

**Let's be clear: when Trump and Musk tore down USAID, they tore down a pillar of America's national security.**

And in the year since, they have continued to sow chaos and corruption at home and around the globe. Yet my Republican colleagues in the Senate have done nothing meaningful to stop it. Time and time again, they bend the knee, refusing to stand up to Trump's dangerous agenda.

**It's become clear that if Republicans won't hold this president accountable for his actions that make our country weaker and all of us less safe, then we need to elect leaders who will.**

[_**But I need you in this fight with me, Derek. Virginia is at the center of the battle for the House and Senate. Winning here is critical if we are going to flip control of Congress in November. Can I count on you to pitch in to my campaign today?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125626517/602399915/1988672456?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_USAID_260218_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNTRmN2U5My1kYzBjLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sxxmYFL0FMzPjcxtjwqTQg2DlNwG6Z-ECTZowUMdcj4=) clean_body: One year ago, Trump and Musk shut down USAID | | | = Derek, this month marks a grim milestone – one year ago, Donald Trump and Elon Musk shut down the United States Agency for International Development, or USAID. I want to talk about why this has been so bad for both the United States and the world, and = When Trump and his allies went after USAID, they said they were cutting "foreign aid." What they actually did was take aim at programs that fight pandemics, feed hungry kids, and grow economies. And the damage doesn't stop at our borders. Gutting USAID is dangerous for Americans right here at home. The truth is, USAID was one of the smartest investments America made in its own security and prosperity – and it’s why I fought like hell to protect it. = USAID contracts supported American farmers who feed the world, and keep our children healthy. It stopped pandemics before they arrived at our shores. It created over 10,000 American jobs at home and overseas – including many right here in Virginia. And USAID helped us counter foreign powers like China and Russia that are seeking to expand their global influence and undermine the United States' global leadership. Let's be clear: when Trump and Musk tore down USAID, they tore down a pillar of America's national security. And in the year since, they have continued to sow chaos and corruption at home and around the globe. Yet my Republican colleagues in the Senate have done nothing meaningful to stop it. name: Jack Schlossberg
subject: My grandfather, JFK
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?refcode=021826_1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?refcode=021826_1]
Lately, I've been doing some reflecting on my grandfather, President John F. Kennedy, and his legacy of hope.
In my run to fight for NY-12 in Congress, and just as a person, that's what I want to focus on. Hope.
My name is Jack, or John Bouvier Kennedy Schlossberg if you want to know the whole thing.
In high school, I spent hours watching my grandfather's speeches. He taught us all that politics isn't about serving yourself — it's about serving others. When we fight for hope, we're not just doing it for ourselves, we're doing it for each other and the future we all have to share.
I know I have big shoes to fill. In my grandfather's memory, I've led a life of caring about this a lot. I put that care and effort and hope into everything I do.
But this is bigger than me. It's bigger than my family's legacy.
Hope is hard to find in Politics these days, but if we let it die out completely, that's how we really lose. Now cannot be the time to stop caring or turn away. We have to double down in our pursuit of hope.
I really think this election is the one — our last chance to stop Trump and change the direction we're heading in.
I need you to know that I believe we can do it. I believe in hope, and I believe in us. Will you believe with me? You can make a difference by splitting a donation between our campaign for NY-12 and Outrage then Action PAC today >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?refcode=021826_1]

Crossover is here, which means that legislation from the House and Senate has crossed over and will go to the other chamber to be heard again. Bills that cross over are one step closer to landing on the governor's desk. Here are a few bills from our "Virginia You Can Afford" Agenda that are making their way to a new chamber this week:
The Affordable Medicine Act: [HB483](https://dpxqxvhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001eIJF-3jrab-ERroGJ9wY8zRW1p1wXz3rwaQVzzpnEa1HSkxGf-xmy_CeM1C6RW2qv371dh2sVU3brVpirfvzC_rWJXrauKqq86UXgVwpQePfx7vxrLkzWG6YQaRKd1CsfSoStnr7rfqNy1BLR2soJ_T1UwSY-9s9Dn02vLALW3LoYopHtKq5hIvvZaolqUwA&c=um3AwT3dRBZqvlCytzeVGtE0D9wTgIvnG2Poi2LxcMaFOoQdqE-Uqw==&ch=9d4nIVrn4_79SnghYrRPsnBts66pRt4jrPNT8_ThyP5LympeHqmYCA==), patroned by Delegate Karrie Delaney, and [SB271](https://dpxqxvhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001eIJF-3jrab-ERroGJ9wY8zRW1p1wXz3rwaQVzzpnEa1HSkxGf-xmy_CeM1C6RW2qlfin6D2vOA-RWPQb9slqduKeOBwneZvE86YCovRPCy9dklWnC1HO5aiT3P6ekxokysjKaoAgguuIDrCUie8IF4pkwgDBovV9WGGcdd1WdgoKeDQ6vh1rAJ-cvRsN2j5A&c=um3AwT3dRBZqvlCytzeVGtE0D9wTgIvnG2Poi2LxcMaFOoQdqE-Uqw==&ch=9d4nIVrn4_79SnghYrRPsnBts66pRt4jrPNT8_ThyP5LympeHqmYCA==), patroned by Senator Creigh Deeds, to establish a Prescription Drug Affordability Board with the authority to expand federally negotiated Medicare drug prices for 25 high-cost prescription drugs to hundreds of thousands of Virginians, has passed their chambers of origin with growing bipartisan support.
Legislation to Ensure Access to Affordable Housing:

| | | | | | Peter,
I’m thrilled to share some tremendous news from the heart of the Hill Country: The [**Fredericksburg Tea Party**](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=9874ac9a2e&e=4d3fe76c62) has proudly endorsed my campaign for Congress in Texas CD-21!
---
[|

| |

Angela Smith, President of the **Fredericksburg Tea Party** , had this to say:
_"The Fredericksburg Tea Party proudly endorses Trey Trainor for Congress in Texas CD-21. Trey is a proven constitutional conservative who has spent his career defending limited government, individual liberty, free markets, election integrity, and the God-given rights enshrined in our Constitution. His unwavering service as FEC Chairman under President Trump, combined with his courage in standing against federal overreach and partisan lawfare, demonstrates the principled leadership we need in Washington. Trey will fight to secure our borders, cut wasteful spending, protect our freedoms, and restore accountability to government—values we hold dear in the Hill Country. We urge voters to support Trey Trainor in the March 3, 2026 Republican Primary."_
This endorsement from such a respected grassroots conservative group means a great deal to me and our campaign. The Fredericksburg Tea Party represents the true spirit of limited government, fiscal responsibility, and constitutional principles that so many of us in CD-21 cherish.
As we head into the final stretch before the March 3 Republican Primary, endorsements like this from trusted local organizations reinforce why I'm running: to bring principled, proven conservative leadership to Washington—fighting for secure borders, lower taxes, election integrity, and restoring accountability to a bloated federal government.
With early voting already underway, your support is more important than ever. Please share this exciting news with your friends, family, and neighbors across the district. Together, we can send a strong message that CD-21 stands for constitutional conservatism.
If you'd like to learn more about our campaign, visit [**trey4tx.com**](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=912b3a04d6&e=4d3fe76c62), [**donate**](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=9721cc710c&e=4d3fe76c62), or[**get involved**](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=260e7bba1b&e=4d3fe76c62), head over there today. Every bit of help counts in this competitive primary.
Thank you for your continued support and for standing with us in this fight for Texas values.
For limited government and liberty,
**Trey Trainor** Husband, Father of 6,Proven Conservative Fighter for TX-21

| Peter, The first big election for Democrats this year is here.
On April 7, Wisconsin voters will decide the future of their State Supreme Court. And with less than two months to go, the race is already exploding.
Last year, Democrats flipped the Wisconsin Supreme Court and secured a 4 to 3 majority. Now, with another seat up for grabs, we have a chance to expand that majority to 5 to 2.
If we win this race, Democrats could lock down control of this critical swing state court until at least 2030.
That means protecting voting rights. Protecting reproductive freedom. Protecting democracy itself in one of the most important battleground states in the country.
And the race has officially begun.
Liberal Judge Chris Taylor just launched the first major ad campaign of the race, warning that extremist judges like her MAGA opponent Maria Lazar are coming for basic benefits like BadgerCare and even trying to enforce Wisconsin's 1849 abortion ban.
Within days, Lazar fired back with a six figure ad blitz of her own calling Taylor a radical and absurdly claiming she wants non-citizens to vote.

That's why Defend Our Courts is jumping in to help Wisconsin Democrats defeat Lazar. But we need to move fast to be prepared for the inevitable onslaught of MAGA cash, disinformation, and smears.
Last year, we helped lead the successful defense of the Pennsylvania Supreme Court, locking in a Democratic majority there until 2029. Now, we are taking our winning formula national.
Wisconsin is our first major test of 2026.
If we are going to stop MAGA, we need to build the war chest now so we are ready to counter every attack the moment it comes.

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
NPR: David Steiner of FedEx is tapped to be the U.S. Postal Service's new leader [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA007/1/89215/images/NPR_PostmasterGeneral.png]
President Donald Trump and the USPS Board of Governors named former Waste Management CEO David Steiner to lead the Postal Service. Steiner was most recently the lead independent director at FedEx, a USPS competitor.
Brian Renfroe, president of the National Association of Letter Carriers — a union representing nearly 300,000 active and retired letter carriers — called the decision to place Steiner at the head of the USPS " an aggressive step toward handing America's mail system over to corporate interests ."
We want to hear from supporters in your area about this tactic. Will you take our one-click poll right away?

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. | | I am a proponent of moving away from the use of rockets for our space travel needs, not only are rockets extremely cost inefficient but as well not at all benefit for the environment. rockets are the Technology of the past, 1950 called, it wants its rockets back. Currently, all jokes aside the most used fuel in use in rocket launches is _RP-1_ this is a highly refined kerosene formulation. we have significantly increased our launches from 70 launches in 2010 and subsequently in 2021-2022, 132. according to [spacegeneration.org](https://austin4rep.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=420fe74918749499acefd8e3e&id=bf0626c462&e=52f43d1c2e) who put out a report on the environmental impact of rocket launches.
** we must move thing faster and more frequently, we can and must make the move away from an old technology and take steps to lead the world in **_**NEXT**_**Generation spaceflight.**

| | [**Environmental Impact of Rocket Fuel**](https://austin4rep.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=420fe74918749499acefd8e3e&id=de27a46d38&e=52f43d1c2e) ‘Toxic rocket fuels are disastrous to the environment. They contaminate the upper atmosphere, where the accumulation of combustion byproducts contributes to ozone layer loss (Dallas,2020). Rocket propellant also harms ecosystems on Earth: one notable example isunsymmetrical dimethylhydrazine (UDMH), a fuel dubbed “Devil’s Venom” by the Sovietscientists who invented it.’
‘Russian proton rockets launched with UDMH from the Kazakh Stepperesulted in multiple major accidents (the Nedelin disaster of 1960 and a similar failure in 2013), contaminating the local environment (Gingerich, 2015). The US is in a position to set a global precedent for regulating rocket fuels, avoiding similar disasters on American soil. There are four commonly used propellant classe.’(to learn more check out [Liquid-propellant rocket engines](https://austin4rep.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=420fe74918749499acefd8e3e&id=9b1345b39a&e=52f43d1c2e))

* Total payload for 6 launches: 200 tons × 6 = 1,200 ton
* The cost per kilogram to orbit using the SpaceX Starship under these conditions is approximately $93.66/kg even if payload is 180 tons it would still be $94.

if we were to invest into mass drivers/startram hybrid systems we could potently launch for $30 to $50 per kilogram of payload launched, physics.org did a wonderful article on the cost savings of a system such as this,
[Maglev track could launch spacecraft into orbit](https://austin4rep.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=420fe74918749499acefd8e3e&id=d609d39209&e=52f43d1c2e)
If you intend to build anything on the moon, a nuclear reactor or mass driver to extend humanities reach to Mars, we need the most reliable, quickest, cost-effective means of moving things and people into orbit. rockets are not it.

### **The Fake DOJ Jeffery Epstein ‘Client list’ Release:**
---
| |
Due to the [overhype of the Epstein “Client List”](https://austin4rep.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=420fe74918749499acefd8e3e&id=dfcc4a5510&e=52f43d1c2e) pressure was on Attorney General Pam Bondi to produce a list of names related to the Jeffery Epstein saga from almost day one of the administration. However, she faced a dilemma, Donald Trump’s name was in the files over a million times. In an effort to stall the public, By February 21st 2025 [Bondi began saying the Epstein client list 'sitting on my desk right now,'](https://austin4rep.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=420fe74918749499acefd8e3e&id=e701c324a6&e=52f43d1c2e) and in an attempt to distract the public said she was also reviewing JFK, MLK files. on February 25th 2025 a bipartisan effort by both sides of congress to [pressure the release client list began.](https://austin4rep.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=420fe74918749499acefd8e3e&id=2c6845c008&e=52f43d1c2e) February 27th 2025 AG Pam Bondi [produced and released a large binder label the Epstein client list](https://austin4rep.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=420fe74918749499acefd8e3e&id=0cec84d7c2&e=52f43d1c2e), this was largely already publicly known information and produced a huge right-wing backlash. On February 28th, 2025, Pam accused departments under her preview of withholding files. yes, [Attorney General Pam Bondi Accuses FBI Of Withholding Jeffrey Epstein Files](https://austin4rep.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=420fe74918749499acefd8e3e&id=f0e9097d1c&e=52f43d1c2e). However, this highlighted that the FBI was in position of large amounts of Jeffery Epstein material and so began the Epstein Files.
---
| |

### **The Epstein Files Cover up:**
---
| |
On May 19th 2025 in an attempt to kill the Jeffery Epstein conspiracy [FBI Director Kash Patel sat for a Sunday Morning Future on Fox News](https://austin4rep.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=420fe74918749499acefd8e3e&id=c37db45cc2&e=52f43d1c2e) saying Epstein took his own life. This, however, had an adverse backlash effect with the public largely disbelieving Kash and Dan. This in turn forced the FBI to say around May 19, 2025 that they would release the full unredacted [video of the night of Jeffery’s reported ‘suicide’](https://austin4rep.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=420fe74918749499acefd8e3e&id=4928ba532f&e=52f43d1c2e). By July 9th 2025 there was a [full Executive branch effort to kill the Jeffery Epstein story](https://austin4rep.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=420fe74918749499acefd8e3e&id=f137337693&e=52f43d1c2e) by any means necessary. A long time ago, I told you that being Attorney General feels like someone set up 50 chessboards in front of me, and my job is to make smart moves on your behalf across all of them.
At the time, I used this image:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d6d94315-390f-46cb-a4fb-d6562c87f91b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
But state buildings are far less grand, so I'm updating with this:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7f9f3702-6e66-4ec7-a26b-b31c64344969?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I can't update you on 50 chessboards each week, so I usually pick one or two.
For example, we just won a $200 million case against FEMA. That was a big win, so in my last email, I focused on that.
But there's a tension between brevity and reality.
The shorter the email, the less accurately it reflects the actual scope of our work. I often get replies like, "Glad you're tackling X, but what about Y!?" \- when the truth is, I usually _am_ tackling Y, I'm just keeping the email short.
So, this is my attempt to cover a lot of moves from the last few weeks in one go.
Here's a snapshot:
* **Fake Service Dogs:** We convicted a man of 50 felonies for selling fake, untrained "service dogs" to 50 families. He claimed they were trained to help children with developmental needs, but they were actually untrained and dangerous. He is now permanently banned from selling animals and must pay $353,000 in restitution to the defrauded families.
* **Protecting Federal Funds:** We won a case against the EPA when they tried to cut $100 million in funding for North Carolina. This brings the total amount of federal funding we've protected for our state to roughly **$1.6 billion** since I've been AG. We're proud of that number.
* **Saving Medical Research:** We won a permanent injunction against the National Institutes of Health (NIH) to stop a massive cut to medical research funding. They attempted to slash the funding that pays for the labs and logistics behind the science, which would have cost North Carolina hundreds of millions of dollars and threatened thousands of jobs in our research sector. This is one of those cases you didn't hear about much _because_ we won. If we hadn't, it would have been a disaster for our state.
* **Utility Hikes:** We formally intervened in Duke Energy's proposed rate increases of 15 percent over the next two years. This legal mechanism allows my office to become a party to the case, cross-examine experts, and speak up for ratepayers.
* **Mercedes-Benz Settlement:** We joined other AGs to secure a nearly $150 million settlement regarding "defeat devices" \- software designed to cheat emissions tests by altering performance when regulators are monitoring the vehicle.
* **Suing Uber:** We sued Uber for deceptive billing practices, specifically regarding unjustified cancellation fees and the use of design choices intended to trick users. Uber promoted a $9.99 a month subscription service and told customers they could cancel anytime. In reality, Uber misled people about how much they could save and made it difficult to cancel after they signed up. In some instances, Uber required customers to navigate up to 23 screens, take at least 32 actions, and wait for a response from a customer service representative to cancel. That's deceptive, and that's why we're suing.
* **Hyundai & Kia Thefts:** We reached a $9 million settlement regarding the security flaw that made Hyundai and Kia cars viral targets for theft due to their lack of standard engine immobilizers. (This was why there was a TikTok trend telling people how easy it was to steal these cars.)
* **Medicaid Fraud:** We secured convictions in two major Medicaid fraud cases involving medical providers who billed the system for care they never provided, recovering over $20 million for state taxpayers. This was egregious fraud that stole money from taxpayers.
* **" Buy Now, Pay Later" Inquiry:** We launched an official inquiry into "Buy Now, Pay Later" lenders like PayPal and Klarna to see if they're violating the Truth in Lending Act and trapping users in debt cycles. These lenders are exploding in popularity because they've been integrated into the checkout process for a lot of major online retailers, and it means lots of people - especially young people - could be vulnerable to deceptive practices.
* **Predatory Real Estate:** We won a judgment against a company called MV Realty, whose predatory business model involved giving homeowners a little bit of money up front in exchange for them signing a 40-year exclusive listing agreement that was recorded as a lien on their property. We put a lot of work into this because it was highly abusive to low-income homeowners. The General Assembly actually passed a law specifically banning this practice as a result of this case.
* **Crime Lab Milestone:** Some folks don't know that NCDOJ also runs the state's three biggest crime laboratories. Last week, those labs hit a milestone of 10,000 hits on gun evidence using the national ballistics information system, which analyzes shell casings to link crimes across different jurisdictions. Every time a bullet is fired, the gun leaves marks on the shell casing that are highly distinct, which allows this technology to determine if the same gun was used at two different shootings. North Carolina is a national leader in the use of this technology, and it's a remarkable milestone that it has now produced 10,000 leads for law enforcement in cases that involved a shooting.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d1341bf4-5631-41d9-935c-ccb3ad96b827?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Generic Drug Prices:** We have a big case against generic drug manufacturers, whom we allege are engaged in a massive market allocation conspiracy to keep prices artificially high. They launched a fight to try to get our lawsuit dismissed, but they failed. That was a big step forward for the case.
* **Rental Market Collusion:** We secured a settlement from Greystar, the state's largest landlord (25,000 units). This is part of our larger suit against RealPage, a software company used by landlords to share private data and collude to raise rents.
* **UNC-Duke:** We got reports of scammers using social media to sell counterfeit tickets to the UNC-Duke men's basketball game, so we responded to those complaints and issued an alert about the scam.

Finally, we saw progress on some things I can't fully discuss yet, like:
* Our effort to defeat the safe haven for money laundering provided by the global messaging app WeChat
* Shutting down an unlicensed mine in western North Carolina
* More work getting FEMA to support post-Helene recovery
* Expanding our war against robocalls

So that's a lot, but it's just a fraction of the _**10,000 active cases** _we have at NCDOJ. There's just a lot going on.
That said, this job is a joy. The people around me are brilliant and dedicated, our battles are worthy, and we win a lot. I love coming to work each morning.
Thanks for making it to the bottom of a long email, and I promise the next one will be shorter :)
Best,
Jeff

UNC-Duke: We got reports of scammers using social media to sell counterfeit tickets to the UNC-Duke men's basketball game, so we responded to those complaints and issued an alert about the scam. Finally, we saw progress on some things I can't fully discuss yet, like: Our effort to defeat the safe haven for money laundering provided by the global messaging app WeChat Shutting down an unlicensed mine in western North Carolina More work getting FEMA to support post-Helene recovery Expanding our war against robocalls So that's a lot, but it's just a fraction of the 10,000 active cases we have at NCDOJ. There's just a lot going on. That said, this job is a joy. The people around me are brilliant and dedicated, our battles are worthy, and we win a lot. I love coming to work each morning. | | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tanx4o&__onlt=h)

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.
