You remember what happened last spring. Elon Musk dumped over $20 million into the race to try and buy the court. Democrats fought back, raising enough money from small dollar donations and outorganized the richest man in the world.

But now, Elon is back... just in time for Wisconsin Dems to kick his ass again.

Since the day after the 2024 election, I’ve heard one question again and again from folks across the Third District: “What can I do?”
That’s why we are launching the Doors For Democracy Tour: four canvassing opportunities all across the Third District to support candidates up and down the ballot. Elections aren’t won in November. They’re won when we brave the heat or the bitter cold to knock doors and hear directly from our neighbors. They’re won when we support candidates up and down the ballot as we build momentum well in advance of any Election Day.
Columbia – Saturday, March 7th at 9 a.m.
Featuring Senator Guy Guzzone, Delegate Pam Guzzone, Delegate Gabriel Moreno, Amy Brooks & Christiana Rigby
SIGN UP FOR COLUMBIA [https://mobilize.us/s/7QiUoY]
Ellicott City – Saturday, March 14th at 10 a.m.
Featuring Senator Katie Fry Hester & Delegate Courtney Watson
SIGN UP FOR ELLICOTT CITY [https://mobilize.us/s/Cb63YS]
Annapolis – Saturday, March 15th at 2 p.m.
Featuring Senator Shaneka Henson, Delegate Dana Jones & Delegate Dylan Behler
SIGN UP FOR ANNAPOLIS [https://mobilize.us/s/dV24ER]
Glen Burnie – Sunday, March 22nd at 1 p.m.
Featuring Senator Pam Beidle, Delegate Mark Chang, Delegate Sandy Bartlett, State’s Attorney Anne Colt Leitess & Councilwoman Allison Pickard
SIGN UP FOR GLEN BURNIE [https://mobilize.us/s/dnu6pi]
Carroll County is on deck!
Please note: Exact locations will be provided upon Mobilize RSVP.
There is too much at stake this year to sit on the sidelines. I hope you join us knocking on doors and talking to neighbors in your community to build the groundwork for November.
See you on the doors,
Sarah Elfreth

Election Day is not where election integrity starts. It starts weeks and months earlier, at the point of registration. If the voter rolls are sloppy, everything downstream gets ugly: lawsuits, distrust, "my side cheated" accusations, and a steady drip of cynicism that poisons self government.
That is why the SAVE Act effort matters. In plain English, it says: if you are registering to vote in federal elections, you prove you are a U.S. citizen. No more "check the box and trust me" as the main gatekeeper. The bill would amend the federal registration framework so states do not accept a federal election registration unless the applicant provides documentary proof of citizenship.
Supporters are right about the principle. Citizenship is the bright line for federal voting. If a country cannot enforce who is eligible to participate, it cannot honestly claim to be governed by its own people. The point is not to accuse your neighbor. The point is to remove incentives for bad behavior and to make the rules real, not theoretical. Even critics generally concede that non citizens voting in federal elections is already illegal, but this debate exists because "illegal" is not the same thing as "impossible."
The bill's mechanics are straightforward but significant. It ties the citizenship check into the places where registration happens, including the motor vehicle office, and it tightens the federal mail registration form rules. It also leans on cross checking tools, including comparisons through the Department of Homeland Security's SAVE system to help states identify non citizens on the rolls, with notice and an opportunity to respond.
Here is the honest tradeoff: this is a bigger compliance lift for states and it adds friction for some lawful citizens. That friction is not imaginary. People change names. Older records are messy. Some folks do not have a passport sitting in a drawer. The bill text tries to address part of that reality by requiring a process for name discrepancies and by allowing states to create an alternative path for applicants who cannot produce standard documentary proof, with an attestation under penalty of perjury and a documented determination by officials. Those safeguards are essential, because the goal is to block illegal registration, not to trap legitimate voters in a paperwork maze.
#### So where is it right now?
An earlier version, H.R. 22, passed the House on April 10, 2025 (220 to 208) and was received in the Senate the same day. More recently, on February 11, 2026, the House passed an updated "SAVE America Act" style package by 218 to 213 and sent it to the Senate. In procedural terms, the current vehicle in the Senate is S. 1383, which the House amended by swapping in the SAVE language; the Senate received the House message on February 12, 2026.
Next steps are simple but politically hard. The Senate must take it up and either concur with the House amendment or amend it again. If the Senate amends, it goes back to the House. If both chambers pass the same text, it goes to Donald Trump to sign or veto. And because the Senate runs on the filibuster for most big fights, supporters likely need 60 votes to move it.
If Congress wants this to be a win for integrity instead of a bureaucratic bludgeon, the implementation needs to be practical: broad acceptance of common documents, clean handling for name changes, accessible verification options, and clear notice and cure procedures. Get those guardrails right, and the country gets something we badly need: election results that more Americans can trust, without turning voting into a scavenger hunt.

---|---|---
* * *
### The Bad Bunny Moment
Mike opens with what he calls a pivotal inflection point: Bad Bunny's performance at the Super Bowl, performed entirely in Spanish on the biggest stage in American entertainment. While Latino artists like Shakira, J.Lo, and Gloria Estefan have headlined before, this was different.
Thanks for reading! Subscribe for free to receive new posts, new episodes and support The Latino Vote Podcast.
[Pledge your support](https://substack..J1QWJ7NXRhphzM_xqpAHM2yb_iAxG2lQBsaihd2w6K0?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=188394767)
This was an artist whose entire brand exists in a separate language--no apologies, no translation, just unapologetic cultural presence at the center of American life.
The backlash was predictable. But it reveals something crucial: **The people most driven by English-only ideology and "great replacement" fears are becoming a smaller share of the population.** And like a dwarf star, they're getting more intense and angry as they shrink. Until they eventually explode.
Mike has seen this before--in California in the 1990s with Prop 187, in Arizona with SB 1070 and Sheriff Joe Arpaio. The GOP animated by racial animus became a marginalized faction in California politics. And nationally? Republicans are making the same mistakes "by tenfold," he says.
* * *
### Hard Truths About Latino Leadership
This is where Mike turns the critique inward, directly at Latino leadership itself.
The economic opportunity that immigrant groups have found in America for 250 years isn't here the way it should be for Latinos. And Mike puts the blame squarely on Latino leaders themselves.
"If we keep looking for the system to fix itself, if we keep waiting for the parties to do right by us, it's never going to happen," he says. "That has never happened in history."
His challenge to elected officials--whether on school boards, city councils, state legislatures, or Congress--is pointed: **What are you doing to ameliorate the system, not just patch it up?**
* * *
### The Damning Statistics
Madrid doesn't mince words when he cites the numbers: **70% of Latino take remedial classes when they graduate high school.**
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/d705ae2b-12b9-41bc-9933-09d3d8bd6327?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In blue states and cities, he argues, you can't blame Republicans for that. "That's on Democratic leadership. And how long are you going to put up with it?"
He questions what kind of legacy Latino leaders want: "You want a park named after you because housing got worse? Because our kids couldn't read? Because healthcare became further out of reach?"
* * *
### The Sign of Hope
After what he calls his "ranting and berating," Madrid pivots to hope.
**The biggest sign of hope isn 't coming from political leadership. It's coming from Latino voters themselves.****
Latino voters are punishing both parties for their failures. Recent special elections in Texas and races throughout 2025 and 2026 show massive Latino shifts away from both Republicans and Democrats.
Meanwhile, Madrid notes, Black and white voters remain largely static, "getting angrier, more racially polarized, doing the same thing their communities have done for 150 years, and wondering why nothing gets better."
**Latino voters are voting the way democracy is supposed to work.** When politicians fail, they fire them--regardless of party affiliation.
* * *
### The Call to Action
Mike's message to Latino leaders is clear:
**If you 're a Latino Democrat, be an advocate for the Latino community first and a Democrat second.**
**If you 're a Latino Republican, be a Latino first and a Republican second.**
Change doesn't come from yelling louder about the other party, he argues. It comes from standing up to your own party and forcing change from within. He cites his own experience co-founding the Lincoln Project as an example of Republicans finally willing to fight against what was wrong in their own party.
**" Stop patching the fence. Replace the whole damn fence."**
\---
**Is Mike right? Are Latino voters leading the way in holding both parties accountable? Share your thoughts in the comments.**

| | I’ve been in public service for 30 years, working as a prosecutor, county executive, and now as Maryland’s United States Senator. But nothing, and I mean _nothing,_ in my life has been more rewarding or inspiring than watching my daughter Alex grow into the bright, confident young woman she is today. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/40194?t=9&amount=25&akid=3457%2E52803%2E66EoHV) In 2023, when I was considering a run for Senate, she was my earliest and proudest supporter. She gave me the push I needed to get off the fence and into the game. That meant juggling a full-time job and a full-time campaign, but I made it clear I’d still drive her to school every morning. I cherish those memories now that she’s away at college. Alex has always been my North Star. She keeps me looking forward to the America she’ll inherit someday, and gives me the strength to never stop fighting for a better, safer, freer country. **I’m in the Senate to go farther and do better not just for Alex, but for all the daughters of Maryland.** I've worked to increase funding and treatment for uterine cancer and fibroids, strengthen protections for victims of domestic violence, get quality reproductive care for military families, and more. body:
New Hampshire’s Senate race is tied. And I’m rattled.
Folks, it’s James Carville.
I’ve worked on more campaigns than I can count, and let me tell you: **I don’t rattle easily.**
But this race in New Hampshire? **It’s TIED. In a dead heat. And that should scare the hell out of every Democrat in the country.**
**[💥 Before you read another word, chip in $10 or whatever you can to help Chris Pappas pull ahead right now.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260218_1.fhjqON&refcode=em20260218-1&t=1&akid=5173%2E582294%2E01iaRE)**

He’s got the name, he’s got the money, and he’s got the full weight of the Republican donor class behind him — from Wall Street to the far-right Super PACs. They see New Hampshire as their ticket to locking down the Senate for another decade.
And right now? **This race is neck-and-neck. It could go either way.**
Chris Pappas is our guy. He’s won the toughest district in New Hampshire four times. He knows how to reach voters across the aisle and build a coalition that wins. But he cannot — _CANNOT_ — do this alone.
So here’s what I need from you:
**[Rush a contribution to Chris Pappas today. $10, $25, whatever you can spare to help Chris take the lead and hold the line in New Hampshire.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260218_1.fhjqON&refcode=em20260218-1&t=3&akid=5173%2E582294%2E01iaRE)**

Peter,
When we launched Colorado Draws the Line, the pundits and critics said it was impossible. They said there was no way we could build enough support to advance a ballot initiative that would give Democrats 3 to 4 additional seats in Congress.
These pundits expected Democrats to just roll over while MAGA redrew the maps in state after state, locking in one-party rule for the next decade and beyond.
But thanks to the support of tens of thousands of Democrats nationwide who have rallied to our cause, we've proven that when Democrats fight, they win.
And now national Democratic leaders are joining the fight. CNN reports that Democratic House Minority leader Hakeem Jeffries is backing our effort to counter MAGA election rigging in Colorado:
---
| [](https://6s79z9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001jq46aNZBdImdtCq9jbYh7YdzLVuMsyDqF2rnKccEz33M5jxzhKz-ZpapHUb2DMMUyI7lR_zKIySFkaQC-Hy-5HmVAg7jpoOxp7KFiCGEPl3shnAG2A9l_eGzQSDugPfd0gnRpzaBBKAB9traGor4hLlxvgCyMbQ2pkR7IWcKGQjMaEmjK2P-Ug_hiNd2X2jUK2IueldilCuqTAyRx-l64dRhTtsPe46_&c=dMCLp-YFyDrtXAzhVFM3Ko90O7Kg3-zNlr1Ck0jkboZEAxN0Qf8Ssw==&ch=SmMc7a3cTBZI_dwYU7ylFFEhKe7NMV2beRxpxLZPZu3oIhSMUnXALw==)

It's on now.
With the cavalry arriving, our ballot initiative just got a massive shot in the arm.
To qualify for the ballot, we need to collect signatures from 2% of registered voters in all 35 of Colorado's State Senate districts. That comes out to nearly 200,000 valid signatures.
Collecting 200,000 signatures means building a massive, statewide ground operation from scratch. We need to recruit, train, and deploy thousands of signature gatherers in every corner of Colorado, from Denver to the Western Slope to the Eastern Plains.
Our team estimates it will take at least $3,000,000 to fund an operation of this scale. Having only launched our efforts a few months ago, we are still well short of that goal.
With national leaders like Hakeem Jeffries stepping up to back our effort, we now have the political muscle behind us. Now we just need the resources to build the massive statewide operation required to put this initiative on the ballot.
That's why we are calling on all Democrats today:
[Peter, we need your support in this fight too. | | Fellow Patriot,
---
| | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus.

He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness.

And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible.

I saw it up close -- _Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. _

But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything.

_**He started observing the Sabbath. **_

Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance.

_But as an act of obedience. _

As a way of saying, **_" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." _**

Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped.

He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield.

No email. No media. No work.

He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children.

It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much.

But over time, it changed him.

And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned...

Colorado is in a behavioral health crisis . We have one of the highest suicide rates in the nation, and it’s not inevitable .
Nearly one in four teenagers has experienced a major depressive episode. And instead of funding care, we’ve turned our prisons and jails into the largest mental health providers in the state.
That’s backwards .
Building more prison beds will not make Colorado safer. Investing in mental health care, substance-use treatment, and community support WILL.
That’s why I’m announcing a key part of my public safety plan: a Community Health and Safety Fund.
Here’s how it works: The corporate bad actors who make our communities less safe will pay for the solutions.
Tech companies are isolating and manipulating our kids. Climate criminals are poisoning our communities. Hospitals and insurers profit by denying care instead of delivering it.
As attorney general, I will use money we recover from suing these companies to fund what actually keeps us safe: behavioral health services, substance-use treatment, preventative care, and access for rural and underserved communities.
If we’re serious about community safety, we need to stop underinvesting in care and make those profiting off harm pay to fix it.
I’m ready to take this on as attorney general. If you’re with me, can you donate today to help us fight for the things that actually make us safe? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_dhs_email-26q1?refcode=x_260218_communityhealth_act]

My parents taught me that America's greatness comes from our diversity, our resilience, and our shared belief that we can do better together. They showed me that when we invest in people and build bridges instead of walls, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
**Friend, our tomorrows can be better than our yesterdays.**
– Pia

* * *
Pia Dandiya is a first-generation American, educator, and public servant who has dedicated her life to expanding opportunity for others. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. name: Justin Streiff, Turning Point USA
subject: Charlie's final book wasn't about politics...
body:
Please read the message below from our sponsor.
* * *
| | | [](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tao2i2&__onlt=h)
---
| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tao2i2&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

**[To claim your copy of this life-changing book, simply make a generous gift in any amount to Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tao2i2&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tao2i2&__onlt=h)
---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

**[To claim your copy of Charlie’s final book, simply make a gift, in any amount, to support Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tao2i2&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tao2i2&__onlt=h)
---
I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible.

Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy.
---
**For Charlie,**

**Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA
---
[](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tao2i2&__onlt=h)
---
**[Support Turning Point USA](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tao2i2&__onlt=h)**
---
**P.S.** When you read **_Stop, in the Name of God,_** you will discover what Charlie found in the Sabbath: a holy rest that steadies the heart, renews the soul, and gives strength for the road ahead.

**[I hope you’ll claim your copy by making your most generous gift to Turning Point USA. Your support fuels our work to build the most faithful generation of Americans in history. Thank you, and God bless!](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tao2i2&__onlt=h)**
---

body:
This isn’t an isolated incident. It’s part of a broader strategy pushed by Donald Trump and MAGA Republicans to lock in power through gerrymandering in states they control, instead of competing for votes.
# [](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/629?refcode=em20260218-188&t=1&akid=188%2E12592%2E6OBWdb)
**What’s unfolding right now in Florida should be a warning to every Virginian who cares about fair elections.**
Republican leaders in Florida are preparing to redraw congressional maps mid-decade — a move that could hand them **_additional seats before a single voter casts a ballot._**
This isn’t an isolated incident. It’s part of a broader strategy pushed by Donald Trump and MAGA Republicans to lock in power through gerrymandering in states they control, instead of competing for votes.
**National leaders are openly acknowledging what’s at stake. As Democratic National Committee Chair Ken Martin put it,_“if Republicans succeed in Florida, the fight over fair representation will only intensify nationwide.”_**
[**Don’t wait for the stakes to get even higher. Can you chip in $3 or anything you can to help us protect Virginians’ representation in Congress?**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260218_1.MPpRmK&amount=3&refcode=20260218-188&t=2&akid=188%2E12592%2E6OBWdb)
When states like Florida and Texas move forward with aggressive gerrymandering without voter approval, it distorts representation across the country. If states that value fair elections do nothing, their voices in Congress risk being diminished.
That is exactly why Virginians for Fair Elections exists: to make sure Virginians, not politicians, stay in control of our maps and representation by voting YES on the fair elections amendment this spring.
This can’t wait.
[**If you’re able, please chip in $3 or whatever you can today to help us educate voters, push back against misinformation, and protect Virginians’ representation before it’s too late.**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260218_1.MPpRmK&amount=3&refcode=20260218-188&t=3&akid=188%2E12592%2E6OBWdb)

It’s part of a broader strategy pushed by Donald Trump and MAGA Republicans to lock in power through gerrymandering in states they control, instead of competing for votes. What’s unfolding right now in Florida should be a warning to every Virginian who cares about fair elections. Republican leaders in Florida are preparing to redraw congressional maps mid-decade — a move that could hand them additional seats before a single voter casts a ballot. This isn’t an isolated incident. It’s part of a broader strategy pushed by Donald Trump and MAGA Republicans to lock in power through gerrymandering in states they control, instead of competing for votes. National leaders are openly acknowledging what’s at stake. As Democratic National Committee Chair Ken Martin put it,“if Republicans succeed in Florida, the fight over fair representation will only intensify nationwide.” When states like Florida and Texas move forward with aggressive gerrymandering without voter approval, it distorts representation across the country. If states that value fair elections do nothing, their voices in Congress risk being diminished. That is exactly why Virginians for Fair Elections exists: to make sure Virginians, not politicians, stay in control of our maps and representation by voting YES on the fair elections amendment this spring. This can’t wait. Republicans have money and power. We have people and the urgency to act. — Team Virginians for Fair Elections

body:
# [#]This is an exclusive newsletter for Scott’s top supporters to stay up-to-date on the campaign and Scott’s work in Congress. If you want to keep Scott fighting for us in Congress, you can click here to donate! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sp-2602-fr?amount=10]
Peter,
Washington has kicked off 2026 the way it ended 2025: with high-stakes negotiations, hard deadlines, and real consequences for families here in San Diego.
Right now, Congress is in ongoing negotiations to rein in ICE – which, under Trump and Secretary Noem, has become a militarized force in our communities with weak training standards and little accountability. ICE cannot continue in its current form, which is why I’m pushing for real safeguards: limits on military-style equipment, always-on body cameras, stronger de-escalation standards, and clear accountability when agents violate the law.
In the meantime, I’m staying focused on delivering results for CA-50: lowering healthcare costs, investing in clean energy and science, strengthening public safety, and securing funding for local priorities.
Read the full update below – and as always, thank you for being part of this team. And, make sure to follow the campaign on Facebook [https://www.facebook.com/scottpeterssandiego] , X [https://twitter.com/ScottPetersSD] , and Instagram [https://www.instagram.com/scottpetersca50] to stay up-to-date.
– Scott
# [#]
Holding ICE Accountable Without Using Families as Collateral Damage
Scott has worked to ensure Congress uses the next negotiating window to demand real accountability and clear standards for ICE operations. After repeated instances of excessive force and reckless tactics – including aggressive raids in San Diego neighborhoods – Scott has pushed commonsense reforms to curb abuse and protect civil rights, while keeping communities safe. Scott’s message has been consistent: accountability and security are not opposing values, and San Diegans should not be forced to choose between them.
★ ★ ★
Preventing a Healthcare Affordability Crisis
After enhanced ACA premium tax credits expired on January 1, healthcare costs surged for families overnight – and San Diego has been hit especially hard. Scott voted to extend these tax credits for three years to prevent premiums from skyrocketing further and to keep pressure on the Senate to act. Nearly 150,000 San Diegans rely on these credits to afford coverage, and tens of thousands are already feeling the impact – including thousands of people in CA-50 alone. Scott continues urging swift Senate action so families aren’t forced to delay care, drop coverage, or go without insurance altogether.
# [#]
Ending the Cross-Border Pollution Crisis
Last year marked a breakthrough in Scott’s years-long effort to end the Tijuana River Valley pollution crisis. In January, the San Diego delegation secured $650 million to fully repair and expand the South Bay International Wastewater Treatment Plant. Scott also passed legislation through the House to expand funding pathways for critical wastewater infrastructure. He invited EPA Administrator Lee Zeldin to tour the site, where Zeldin committed to achieving a “100 percent solution.” In the new year, Scott is continuing to work with partners across all levels of government to protect public health and restore clean water and air for the region.
★ ★ ★
Delivering San Diego Priorities Through Funding Packages
Scott helped pass multiple bipartisan funding packages to keep the government running and invest in the priorities San Diegans care about: lowering energy costs, strengthening public safety, investing in clean energy and science, and upgrading critical water infrastructure. These bills also reassert Congress’s constitutional “power of the purse” – pushing back against the Trump Administration’s slash-and-burn approach and reaffirming that no President can dismantle agencies or ignore Congressional intent without consequences.
★ ★ ★
Turning San Diego Medical Innovation Into Nationwide Results
Scott helped introduce bipartisan legislation to ensure children on Medicaid with suspected rare diseases can access genomic sequencing – a tool that has become the standard of care and can dramatically shorten the “diagnostic odyssey” many families face. The bill was inspired by San Diego’s own Project Baby Bear at Rady Children’s Hospital, which demonstrated that faster diagnosis can save lives and reduce unnecessary healthcare costs.
★ ★ ★
Building Again: A New Push for Permitting Reform
Scott continues leading bipartisan work to fix the broken federal permitting process so America can build the clean energy, housing, roads, bridges, broadband, and transmission we need. After the House passed Scott’s bipartisan ePermit Act in December, Scott and a bipartisan group released a new permitting discussion draft – the CERTAIN Act – focused on fair, efficient timelines and predictable rules that reduce chaos and political interference. The goal is simple: get critical projects built faster, lower costs, and protect the environment with a process that actually works.
# [#]
Preparing for Redistricting After Prop 50’s Passage
At the end of last year, California voters overwhelmingly passed Prop 50, paving the way for new, fairer Congressional maps. With redistricting now underway, Team Peters has already begun preparing for the changes ahead – expanding outreach plans, connecting with community leaders in newly added areas, and laying the groundwork to ensure Scott is meeting voters in every corner of the redrawn district. As the landscape shifts, the team remains focused on making sure all constituents – current and future – have a strong advocate fighting for them in Washington.
★ ★ ★
Fighting for Affordable Housing
Scott joined the YIMBY Democrats of San Diego’s January meeting to discuss housing policy and the work still ahead to build more affordable housing in our region and nationwide.
# [#] ★ ★ ★
Festival of Progressive Abundance
Scott also joined the Festival of Progressive Abundance, a 3-day weekend conference connecting leaders and activists in the Abundance movement. As a featured guest and speaker, Scott reiterated his commitment to improving the quality of life for San Diegans and building a future where we all can succeed and thrive.

name: Kelly Hancock
subject: I need your help.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Texans for Kelly Hancock
body:
Robin and I just want to start by saying thank you.

| | | | | [|
---](https://kellyhancock.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dcaa9ba5f084f891ef21f7388&id=1b12c5b59e&e=c7a460ad3d)
| | | | | | Friends,
**Early voting is officially open, and Robin and I just want to start by saying thank you.**
Truly. This campaign has been powered by your prayers, your encouragement, your time, and your belief in what we’re fighting for. We feel that support every single day.
**Yesterday, I joined Governor Greg Abbott in Cypress as we kickoff a statewide Get-Out-The-Vote tour.** We’re in Allen and Beaumont today, then La Grange and The Colony tomorrow, with more stops coming next week.
We’re in the last mile of this marathon. If you’ve ever run a race, you know this is the moment that matters most. Your legs are tired, the finish line is almost in sight, and everything in you has to decide to push harder. Scripture reminds us to _run with perseverance the race marked out for us_ in life — and that’s exactly what we’re doing together in this campaign.
I’m asking you to help me finish strong by doing three simple but powerful things:
**First,** will you please text 20 people — neighbors, friends, and family — and personally ask them to vote for **Kelly Hancock for Comptroller?** A personal message from someone they trust is more powerful than any ad we could ever buy. [Bring them to an upcoming rally with Governor Abbott!](https://kellyhancock.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dcaa9ba5f084f891ef21f7388&id=786fa549f4&e=c7a460ad3d)
**Second,** please post on social media about why you’re supporting this campaign. Your voice carries weight. The personal touch is worth more than any amount of paid advertising, and it helps us reach people we could never reach on our own. Make sure to follow us on [Twitter/X](https://kellyhancock.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dcaa9ba5f084f891ef21f7388&id=f6d12e0447&e=c7a460ad3d), [Facebook](https://kellyhancock.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dcaa9ba5f084f891ef21f7388&id=482119224c&e=c7a460ad3d), and [Instagram](https://kellyhancock.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dcaa9ba5f084f891ef21f7388&id=064a26f11b&e=c7a460ad3d)!
**Third,** if you’re able, please consider [**making a donation**](https://kellyhancock.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dcaa9ba5f084f891ef21f7388&id=7d96fa64a4&e=c7a460ad3d) to help us get across the finish line. Every dollar helps us connect with voters who aren’t in our circle of supporters just yet — and in a race this close, that outreach makes all the difference.
---
| [CHIP IN >>>](https://kellyhancock.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dcaa9ba5f084f891ef21f7388&id=850363a47e&e=c7a460ad3d)
---
| | This campaign has always been bigger than politics — it’s about stewardship, faith, family, and the future of Texas. Governor Abbott asked me to serve as Comptroller — and endorsed my campaign — because he needs a CFO of Texas he can trust.
We’ve come this far together, and I’m asking you to run this last mile with me.
**Let’s finish strong!**
Gratefully,
Kelly

name: Abdul El-Sayed
subject: One of our primary opponents took a swing at us
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Abdul for U
body:
[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/30?refcode=&t=1001&akid=1714%2E251025%2EyClUzz ]Abdul for US Senate [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/30?refcode=&t=1002&akid=1714%2E251025%2EyClUzz ]Abdul for US Senate

Last week, I had the pleasure of speaking at a forum hosted by UAW, one of
the largest and most diverse unions in the country.

What made it extra special was that, for the first time ever, all of the
candidates for our U.S. Senate race shared a stage... well, minus Mike
Rogers, who didn’t show up. 🦗

[ An ]An empty chair with Mike Rogers' name on it

While he spent time elsewhere (probably in Florida), I had the chance to
lay out our vision for working people: Passing Medicare for All, taking on
corporate price gouging, protecting unions, and ending the corrupting
influence of corporate PAC money in our politics.

However, at one point, one of our primary opponents took a swing at us.
They said this:

“We do not have to settle for somebody who prioritizes rhetoric over
results, who’s never held office, who’s never delivered for you.”

Let me clear something up,
Peter. When
politicians call our values “rhetoric,” what they really mean is they’re
unwilling to fight for them — or are funded not to.

And when they say we’ve “never delivered,” they’re just wrong.

Together, we’ve canceled $700 million in medical debt for 300,000
Michiganders.

We gave tens of thousands of kids free glasses so they could thrive in
school.

We’re fighting to build a Democratic Party that doesn’t wait to see what’s
popular before taking a stance. We make popular what’s morally right.

And we’ve done this all without ever taking a cent from corporate PACs or
AIPAC. That’s something no one else in this Senate race can say.

Now, we’re running to deliver on a bigger scale, and I need your help.

This race is going to come down to resources. The candidates backed by
corporate PACs and wealthy donors will have plenty of them. Mike Rogers
will have MAGA money lined up in the general.

What I have is you,
Peter.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260218-1-ak.ejb-OJ&amount=10&refcode=em20260218-1713&t=1004&akid=1714%2E251025%2EyClUzz ]Will you chip in $10 or whatever you can today to help us
out-organize and out-raise the other candidates in this race? Our campaign
is 100% powered by people like you, so even donating a few bucks makes a
difference. 🙏

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260218-1-ak.ejb-OJ&amount=10&refcode=em20260218-1713&t=1023&akid=1714%2E251025%2EyClUzz ]Donate $10 ››

In solidarity,

Abdul

# [Oil spikes as Trump threatens Iran strikes](https://substack.com/redirect/ecc2d7a7-f91f-4fa6-99b8-3a8ca8a54b0a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Oil prices **[surged more than 2% Wednesday](https://substack.com/redirect/ecc2d7a7-f91f-4fa6-99b8-3a8ca8a54b0a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after Vice President JD Vance warned that Iran ignored U.S. red lines in Geneva nuclear talks, with President Trump holding military strikes on the table if negotiations collapse, heightening fears over Strait of Hormuz disruptions.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ecc2d7a7-f91f-4fa6-99b8-3a8ca8a54b0a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Vance details stalled talks:** Vice President JD Vance told Fox News the Geneva discussions were partly productive but Iran refused to acknowledge Trump's core demands, agreeing only to future meetings.
* **Iran claims constructive progress:** Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi described the U.S.-Iran talks as serious and constructive, announcing a general agreement on guiding principles per Iranian state media.
* **Strait of Hormuz war games:** Iran's Revolutionary Guard held exercises this week, temporarily closing sections of the vital strait where one-third of global seaborne crude passes, amplifying supply risk concerns.
* **U.S. military buildup escalates:** Trump has deployed the USS Abraham Lincoln carrier group in the Middle East with the USS Gerald Ford en route as a contingency, stating forces would be needed if no deal emerges.

# **[Trump hails massive $36 billion Japan investment surge](https://substack.com/redirect/e2392d61-1307-4c33-bf3f-e8d27c01b7c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
President Donald Trump **[celebrated Japan's pledge of nearly $36 billion](https://substack.com/redirect/e2392d61-1307-4c33-bf3f-e8d27c01b7c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in initial investments for U.S. oil, gas and critical mineral projects in Texas, Ohio and Georgia on February 18, 2026, marking the launch of a landmark 2025 trade deal that secured lower tariffs in exchange for Tokyo's $550 billion commitment to bolster American energy and economic security.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e2392d61-1307-4c33-bf3f-e8d27c01b7c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Ohio gas mega-plant** : SB Energy, a SoftBank subsidiary, will build the world's largest natural gas generation facility in Portsmouth at $33 billion, delivering 9.2 gigawatts of power.
* **Texas oil export boost** : Japan finances the $2.1 billion GulfLink deepwater crude terminal, poised to enable up to $30 billion in annual U.S. crude exports at full capacity.
* **Georgia mineral advance** : Approximately $600 million funds an Element Six synthetic diamond grit facility, enhancing U.S. industrial manufacturing and national security with critical hard materials.
* **Tariff triumph claimed** : Trump credits his tariff strategy for enabling the deal's massive scale, launching the first tranche of Japan's broader $550 billion investment promise from last year's agreement.

# [Bitcoin invaded Wall Street only to crash hard and questions are being asked](https://substack.com/redirect/ab4f78cd-b440-466c-897b-77925ceb1516?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Bitcoin's **[long-sought Wall Street embrace via spot ETFs and futures has backfired,](https://substack.com/redirect/ab4f78cd-b440-466c-897b-77925ceb1516?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/ab4f78cd-b440-466c-897b-77925ceb1516?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)with billion in outflows from US-listed funds since October 10, 2025, driving a more than 40% price plunge amid retreating American institutional capital--even as stocks and gold draw buyers.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ab4f78cd-b440-466c-897b-77925ceb1516?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Massive ETF Outflows Surge:** Since mid-October 2025, US spot Bitcoin ETFs have seen roughly $8.5 billion in net outflows, reflecting fading institutional demand and sustained selling pressure.
* **CME Futures Exposure Plummets:** Institutional leverage on Chicago Mercantile Exchange futures has dropped about two-thirds from late-2024 peaks to roughly $8 billion, thinning market liquidity and muting price support.
* **Coinbase Discount Signals US Selling:** Bitcoin trades persistently cheaper on US-favored Coinbase versus offshore Binance, highlighting ongoing American investor exits and divergent global demand.
* **Institutional Hedge Thesis Fails:** Bitcoin has underperformed as a hedge against inflation or equity risks, falling faster than traditional assets and prompting rotations to rising gold and stocks instead.

# [Meta & Nvidia tout mega-deal, Millions in AI chips unleashed](https://substack.com/redirect/c073fd92-f2ae-4da6-8e23-43065164cce6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Nvidia and Meta **[announced an expanded multiyear partnership Tuesday,](https://substack.com/redirect/c073fd92-f2ae-4da6-8e23-43065164cce6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with Nvidia supplying millions of Blackwell and upcoming Rubin GPUs plus CPUs as well as networking gear to power Meta's massive AI training and inference in data centers, boosting the social giant's push for advanced models amid soaring compute demands.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c073fd92-f2ae-4da6-8e23-43065164cce6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Multi-Generational Commitment:** Nvidia's deal spans current Blackwell and future Rubin generations, plus Grace and Vera CPUs for Meta's on-premises and cloud deployments via partners like CoreWeave.
* **Standalone CPU Rollout:** Meta launches its first large-scale Nvidia Grace CPU-only servers now, with Vera CPU-only systems planned for 2027, challenging Intel and AMD dominance in traditional server CPUs.
* **Security Integration Boost:** Meta adopts Nvidia Confidential Computing on GPUs to enable private data processing within its WhatsApp app, enhancing user privacy for AI workloads.
* **Market Momentum Lift:** Announcement drove Nvidia shares up nearly 2% premarket and Meta up 0.7%, despite broader 2026 AI stock cooling from spending concerns and rival custom chips.

### [Zuckerberg faces jury over social media addiction claims](https://substack.com/redirect/bda1292e-4b13-4207-9211-4aadf23192ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg is set to testify Wednesday in a landmark Los Angeles trial **[accusing social media giants of deliberately designing addictive platforms](https://substack.com/redirect/bda1292e-4b13-4207-9211-4aadf23192ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that harmed young users' mental health, as a young woman claims Instagram fueled her depression and suicidal thoughts in a case likened to Big Tobacco's reckoning.
* **Zuckerberg Testimony Awaits:** Zuckerberg prepares to take the stand for the first time before a jury on February 18, 2026, defending Meta against claims that Instagram's features exploit young users' vulnerabilities.
* **Plaintiff 's Addiction Allegations:** A now-20-year-old woman alleges early heavy use of Instagram and YouTube addicted her as a child, exacerbating severe mental health issues including depression and suicidal ideation.
* **Industry-Wide Scrutiny Builds:** Snap and TikTok settled pre-trial while Meta and YouTube face ongoing proceedings, with this case seen as a pivotal "Big Tobacco" moment for alleged deception on youth safety.
* **Related Cases Escalate Pressure:** Parallel trials in New Mexico accuse Meta of enabling child exploitation by predators, with more federal cases expected this summer challenging platform designs across Big [Tech.](https://substack.com/redirect/c99f9324-12aa-4318-b76d-7af3df3cf4da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

| | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus.

He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness.

And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible.

I saw it up close -- _Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. _

But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything.

_**He started observing the Sabbath. **_

Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance.

_But as an act of obedience. _

As a way of saying, **_" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." _**

Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped.

He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield.

No email. No media. No work.

He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children.

It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much.

But over time, it changed him.

And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned...

| | Americans are facing a cost of living crisis. Everything from rent to groceries to car payments and everything in between continues to climb in cost, while families make tough choices to get by. That's on full display at the pharmacy counter, where millions of Americans are forced to pay skyrocketing costs while Big Pharma rakes in the profits. Donald Trump has proudly touted his new "TrumpRx" as the solution. The silver bullet that will give patients a more affordable alternative. But here's the truth: TrumpRx is nothing but a glorified coupon book that will leave drugs more expensive for families with health insurance. And on top of that, we know that Trump rarely does anything if there isn't something in it for him to gain. Donald Trump Jr. is on the board of a company that has refused to say whether it was involved with TrumpRx. Donald Trump was president for four years and never once lifted a finger to lower drug costs. Trump when it comes to lower drug prices. My doors are wide open to anybody who wants to take the bold next step forward on lowering drug costs for Americans.** That is why I am leading an effort to actually rein in Big Pharma's outrageous price increases, lower costs for patients, and reduce wasteful government spending that pads the profits of big corporations. Americans are sick of Donald Trump's broken promises. We need leaders who are ready to take bold steps forward and fight for affordable healthcare. body:
https://kellyforcongress.org [https://kellyforcongress.org]
Hi Peter!
I’m reaching out to share the news that I am running for re-election to the US House in Minnesota’s Third Congressional District! 🇺🇲
It is the honor of my lifetime to represent our district in Congress. I love our state and our country, and I feel lucky and proud to be in the fight for our democracy with all of you at this pivotal moment in our nation’s history.
Photo of Kelly speaking at a podium [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP59/1/109390/images/people/kelly-speaking.png]
📸 Taken at one of the town halls I hosted this year. Nearly 1,500 people showed up to Hopkins High School to hear more about our work and join in our fight to save our democracy.
I have never been more proud to be a Minnesotan. When ICE agents flooded our state, Minnesotans showed up for each other and took care of each other. From attending peaceful protests across our state to bringing groceries or running errands for their neighbors who do not feel safe leaving their homes - the compassion we have extended to each other during this time is what will sustain our collective courage. And Minnesotans have made it clear that we are a courageous bunch.
Peter, I had the honor and privilege of caring for Minnesotans as an OBGYN for more than 20 years. I spent most of my working life as a physician, not a politician, and I bring the same ethic from my years taking care of patients to my work as a member of Congress. As a physician, I spend most of my time listening to my patients, crafting a care plan together, and advocating for them to ensure that they are set up to maximize their health and well-being. I approach my work in Congress in the same way: by listening first, putting people at the center of each decision, and fighting for their rights.
Over the past year, this administration - aided by its compliant Republican majorities in Congress - has wreaked havoc on communities across the country. From slashing funding for healthcare and essential services to pay for tax cuts for the wealthiest in their cruelly named “One Big Beautiful Bill” to deploying federal agents to terrorize people in American streets to historic corruption and self-dealing - this administration has flooded the zone to distract from its campaign of cruelty and its march toward authoritarianism.
These are incredibly challenging times for our state and our country, but my determination to fight for my constituents, and all Minnesotans, has never been stronger. There is so much work to be done – from defending our constitutional rights to defending our public lands – and I am ready to keep fighting to strengthen our communities and do everything I can to rein in this runaway administration.
We must flip the U.S. House this November to put the brakes on this administration. There is a path for Democrats to do just that in 2026, but it won’t happen without keeping Minnesota’s Third District blue .
I now have two Republican opponents running against me in this race . MN-03 was held by Republicans for almost 60 years before being flipped blue in 2018, and it will take an all-hands-on-deck effort to keep it blue this November.
To secure re-election, support Democrats up and down the ballot in MN-03, and help win targeted races across the country to win the majority in the U.S. House, we must raise enough to meet our organizing budget to be able to run a strong campaign .
Peter, could you give any amount today to help us kick off my re-election campaign and fund our organizing efforts? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/morrison-email]

Thank you so much, Peter. I look forward to continuing this work together.
With gratitude and resolve,
Kelly Morrison
Congresswoman, MN-03

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: Desert rose

body:
#

Team,
Can I tell you a story? It has to do with this brooch:
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q12026.IDrYd1&refcode=em260218-1-b&t=1&akid=11264%2E3935704%2ErgBk1c)
I grew up in Tucson, Arizona, on the edge of the Sonoran Desert. The desert covers 100,000 square miles and is unforgiving — temperatures often reach 118 degrees in peak summer.
The brooch on my dress is a silver desert rose. It’s known for its ability to bloom even in the most challenging environments. Mark gifted it to me to represent strength and determination, and I’ve worn it ever since.
The trajectory of my life changed in an instant when a gunman shot me in the head. The bullet damaged the left hemisphere of my brain, where the language function sits, leaving me with aphasia.
**The gunman tried to silence me — but like the desert rose, I persevered.**
We never know what life hands us, but what matters most is what we choose to do in the difficult moments. I chose to channel my pain into purpose.
Some days, I feel like we are fighting a similar battle for gun safety. I know sometimes the challenge of ending gun violence in our nation can feel overwhelming. When we see the headlines after a mass shooting — or when we remember the countless tragedies that don’t make the news every day — I know how hard it is to keep fighting.
But we cannot give up. We cannot lose hope. Not when so many lives are on the line.
We are officially in the midterm election year, when millions of Americans will go to the polls. This will be a critical test for the gun safety movement, and our adversaries will be looking to see if we have the resources to elect gun safety champions everywhere.
So this is the part where I ask for your help:
[**Will you make a contribution to GIFFORDS PAC today? We need to raise $25,000 from this email, but we can’t reach it without your help.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q12026.IDrYd1&refcode=em260218-1-b&t=2&akid=11264%2E3935704%2ErgBk1c)

I’m proud to say we are making meaningful progress.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125649538/602472414/1826391520?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDM4NTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMGY2YzI5ZTAtMDEwZC1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhNTc1OTNmIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=q0YasOhVG6AkDTLkqfS4uk2qXQ0aXeQaCyU4B6WTjwE=&emci=a514c9bd-dd0c-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&emdi=0f6c29e0-010d-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&ceid=8470899)
---
| Hi Peter, it’s Crossover Day in Virginia!

If you’re not immersed in the day-to-day work of Richmond, here’s what that means: _“crossover” is the deadline for bills to pass out of their chamber of origin_. Any House bill that hasn’t passed the House, or Senate bill that hasn’t passed the Senate, won’t move forward this session.

In other words, today is a significant milestone. It’s when we see which ideas have real support and momentum.

**From day one, I’ve been focused on a clear priority: lowering costs for Virginia families. That’s the foundation of my Affordable Virginia Agenda. And I’m proud to say we are making meaningful progress.**

**So far this session, the House of Delegates and Senate have passed more than half of the proposals that make up our Affordable Virginia Agenda!** They’ve moved legislation to expand access to health care and lower prescription drug costs, reduce heating and energy bills, increase the supply of affordable housing, and make childcare more accessible for working parents.

Crossover is not the end of the process. Bills that move forward still need to be reconciled, voted on again, and signed into law. But today’s progress sends a clear message: focusing on affordability is the right approach, and it’s the one that resonates across our Commonwealth.

I ran for Governor to make Virginia more affordable, more competitive, and more responsive to the people who call this Commonwealth home. And as we enter the second half of the session, I’ll continue working with members of both parties to move commonsense legislation across the finish line.

Thank you for staying engaged and for being part of this work.

Abigail Spanberger

| | Peter,
---
| | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus.

He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness.

And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible.

I saw it up close -- _Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. _

But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything.

_**He started observing the Sabbath. **_

Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance.

_But as an act of obedience. _

As a way of saying, **_" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." _**

Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped.

He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield.

No email. No media. No work.

He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children.

It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much.

But over time, it changed him.

And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned...

It's not a culture war manifesto.

It's a call to stop.

To rest. To breathe. To return to God.

**Because Charlie believed America hadn 't just forgotten truth... It had forgotten trust. **

Trust that the world keeps spinning when you step away.

Trust that God is in control.

Trust that rest is not weakness -- it's worship.

🔥 How Charlie reclaimed the Sabbath in a world built on burnout

🔥 What sacred rest gave back to him -- as a father, husband, and believer

🔥 Why he believed this message could spark revival in a restless generation

clean_body: | | | | | Peter, | | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud. He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus. He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness. And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible. I saw it up close -- Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything. He started observing the Sabbath. Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance. But as an act of obedience. As a way of saying, " God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped. He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield. No email. No media. No work. He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children. It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much. But over time, it changed him. And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned... This was Charlie's final message. His final act of trust. A book not about politics... but about peace. It 's called: Stop, in the Name of God. Peter, like I mentioned, this isn't a political book. It's not a culture war manifesto. It's a call to stop. To rest. To breathe. To return to God. Because Charlie believed America hadn 't just forgotten truth... It had forgotten trust. Trust that the world keeps spinning when you step away. Trust that God is in control. Trust that rest is not weakness -- it's worship. In Stop, in the Name of God, you'll discover: 🔥 How Charlie reclaimed the Sabbath in a world built on burnout 🔥 What sacred rest gave back to him -- as a father, husband, and believer 🔥 Why he believed this message could spark revival in a restless generation Charlie wrote this book because he knew what it meant to nearly lose his peace -- and what it felt like to find it again. That's the heartbeat of his final message. Charlie Kirk didn't waste his time on earth. He left behind a family. He left behind a movement. And he left behind this truth... For anyone ready to step off the treadmill... and walk back toward what's eternal. Peter, thank you -- in advance -- for helping reach the next generation with truth, faith, and moral courage. These are the very things Charlie gave his life for. May the message he left behind lead you -- just as it led him -- to a deeper trust in God... A stronger love for your family... And a renewed peace in your own soul. For Charlie, Justin Streiff Chief Operating Officer Turning Point USA P.S.Stop, in the Name of God is Charlie Kirk's final message -- written in obedience, shaped by Scripture, and grounded in trust in the Lord. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

They are stripping the EPA of its power to regulate greenhouse gases and dismissing nearly two decades of life-saving protections as “red tape.”
This is not reform. It is reckless and shortsighted.
As the only lung doctor in Congress, I know exactly what this means. When clean air protections are weakened, people get sicker. Kids struggle to breathe. Seniors end up in emergency rooms. Families pay the price.
This is just the latest example of the Trump administration choosing corporate polluters over our health—and putting all of us at risk.
It doesn’t have to be this way. We can prioritize businesses that help our air and environment. Instead, Trump is trying to bring back coal and other fuels that poison our oxygen to score cheap political points and pad the pockets of his mega donors.
We can fight back, but only if we have the resources to take on corporate polluters and the politicians who protect them. clean_body: [] The Trump administration is selling out the air we breathe. They are stripping the EPA of its power to regulate greenhouse gases and dismissing nearly two decades of life-saving protections as “red tape.” This is not reform. It is reckless and shortsighted. As the only lung doctor in Congress, I know exactly what this means. When clean air protections are weakened, people get sicker. Kids struggle to breathe. Seniors end up in emergency rooms. Families pay the price. This is just the latest example of the Trump administration choosing corporate polluters over our health—and putting all of us at risk. It doesn’t have to be this way. We can prioritize businesses that help our air and environment. Instead, Trump is trying to bring back coal and other fuels that poison our oxygen to score cheap political points and pad the pockets of his mega donors. We can fight back, but only if we have the resources to take on corporate polluters and the politicians who protect them. If you believe clean air is a right, not a privilege, chip in today to help us stand up for our health, our families, and our future. name: Anika Page
subject: Dispatch from the Dome: HB 3 Signed Into Law — A Step Toward Healthcare Reform
body:
View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/dome-dispatch-12852126?e=5703353baa)
Good afternoon Friend,

Earlier this month, on February 4, the Governor signed HB 3 into law.

While it may not have grabbed major headlines, this legislation represents one of the most meaningful healthcare policy shifts of the session.

HB 3 — targeted reform of Mississippi’s Certificate of Need (CON) laws — is now officially law.

And while it is not full repeal, it is a real step in the right direction.

Here’s what that means — and why it matters.

** What HB 3 Does
------------------------------------------------------------

For decades, Mississippi’s Certificate of Need laws have required hospitals and healthcare providers to receive government approval before expanding facilities, adding services, or making certain major investments.

In practice, that system can slow growth, limit competition, and make it harder for new providers to enter underserved areas.

HB 3 makes several important changes:
* It raises the dollar thresholds that trigger government approval.
* It creates targeted exemptions.
* And importantly, it begins modernizing a regulatory framework that has not kept pace with today’s healthcare realities.

This bill does not eliminate the CON system entirely. But it does loosen restrictions that have long limited flexibility in our healthcare market.

** The Most Important Piece: A Research Mandate
------------------------------------------------------------

One of the most significant elements of HB 3 is something that hasn’t received as much attention:

The bill directs further study into what it would look like for Mississippi to repeal CON requirements in certain contexts — particularly for rural hospitals.

That research matters.

Mississippi has long struggled with access to care in rural communities. Many areas face hospital closures, limited specialty services, and long travel times for treatment. These gaps contribute to what many refer to as “medical deserts” — areas where patients simply don’t have reasonable access to care.

We also know that Mississippi consistently ranks near the bottom nationally in key health outcomes — and access, competition, and flexibility in our healthcare system are all part of that conversation.

If repealing or further scaling back CON laws for rural hospitals could help expand services, attract providers, or stabilize struggling facilities, that is a policy discussion worth having seriously and thoughtfully.

HB 3 opens the door to that conversation.

** Why This Is a Step Forward
------------------------------------------------------------

Large reforms rarely happen all at once.

More often, they happen in phases — modernizing thresholds, creating exemptions, and eventually rethinking the system more broadly.

HB 3 represents progress. It shows lawmakers are willing to revisit long-standing regulatory structures and ask whether they are still serving Mississippi patients well.

We will continue to advocate for broader reform, particularly where it could expand access in underserved communities. But this is a real and measurable step toward a more flexible, patient-focused healthcare system.

And it’s now law.

** What Comes Next
------------------------------------------------------------

Now that HB 3 has been signed, attention turns to implementation — and to the research it mandates regarding potential additional reforms.

We’ll be watching closely to see:
* how agencies implement the new thresholds and exemptions
* how the rural healthcare research is conducted
* and what recommendations ultimately come from that work

Healthcare access is not an abstract policy issue in Mississippi. It affects families in every corner of our state.

If reform can help strengthen rural hospitals, reduce barriers to care, and improve outcomes, that’s a conversation worth continuing.

As always, I’ll keep breaking it down in plain language and keeping you updated as the session moves forward.

** Track Legislation in Real Time
------------------------------------------------------------

If you’d like to follow along as bills move through the process, you can track key legislation throughout the session using the Mississippi Center for Public Policy’s bill tracker.
Track Bills at the Capitol (https://mspolicy.org/bill-tracker/)
Thanks for staying engaged and informed. I’ll continue tracking these developments and keeping you updated as reform moves forward.

Until next time,

Anika Page
Director of Operations

Meanwhile, HB26-1021, [the Second Amendment Protection Act](https://link.email.joinrmv.), seeks to roll back recent gun restrictions, with with Reps. Bradley and Brooks arguing current policies punish lawful gun owners without reducing crime.
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** A Denver judge is weighing whether to remove a prosecutor and allow child hearsay in the Hawkins case, highlighting [legal complexities in high-profile abuse proceedings](https://link.email.joinrmv.). [Human trafficking cases surged in 2025](https://link.email.joinrmv.), intensifying calls for tougher enforcement. A judge also ruled [certain prison work policies unconstitutional](https://link.email.joinrmv.), while a new study alleging [hundreds of thousands of voter record changes](https://link.email.joinrmv.) post-certification renewed election integrity concerns. A northern Colorado rancher says [wolves killed the family dog](https://link.email.joinrmv.), reigniting tensions over reintroduction. The appeals court is reviewing [whether Tina Peters’ bond denial violated free speech protections](https://link.email.joinrmv.). And critics say Denver’s urbanism push, including expanded bike lanes, reflects a [broader effort to discourage car use](https://link.email.joinrmv.).
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** A new commentary argues America’s real election crisis is a [collapse of public trust](https://link.email.joinrmv.), with voters across parties questioning integrity amid mail-in expansion and delayed results. The author calls for voter ID, proof of citizenship, one-day voting, and same-day results, arguing that transparency and uniform standards are essential to restoring confidence in the system.
This is your Mountain Minute for Wednesday, February 18, 2026.
– Team RMV

**[Speech or statute? Appeals court weighs bond denial in Tina Peters case](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
The Colorado Court of Appeals is being asked to decide whether Tina Peters was denied bond because of her speech—or whether the issue is already foreclosed by appellate rules.
Was her bond denied because of her speech?
The Attorney General’s office argues the court does not need to answer that question. In its view, Peters’ petition is untimely, successive and barred under Colorado’s appellate rules.
The dispute now before the court centers on bond pending appeal. The defense says a district judge treated Peters’ public criticism of Mesa County’s voting system as a public danger. The state says the bond statute independently supports denial and that the petition should be dismissed on procedural grounds.
