body:
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=240694%2E444211%2EAePKKR)
I was walking from the parking lot at the University of North Texas over to where our volunteers were setting up our canvassing program, when Kennedy came up to me and just opened up, nearly in tears, about how bad things have become and how hard it is for her to see us getting through it all. Strange how it works, but I was feeling just as low down as she was this morning, just sinking with the weight of everything I'd read in the news and all the work that I know lies ahead, but somehow her opening up to me turned me back around to where I needed to be. And I hope my talking to her did the same.
It was in that spirit that I caught up with our volunteers and for the next five hours we just got after it, meeting every student we could, checking their registration, listening to what's on their mind, trying to share our hope and optimism rooted in the work that we're doing, and then making a commitment to stay in touch for the next nine months to ensure that we all vote when it really counts.
I heard uplifting and amazing stories, like Jonah, who'd recently moved from Kentucky and was organizing his fellow students at UNT. I heard tough ones, like Ashley who told me her dad, who's lived in North Texas for the last 33 years, had recently been picked up by ICE and was in the process of being deported to Mexico, a country he hasn't been to since he was a kid. She's studying construction management, is focused on her career, on making the most of the opportunity her dad is giving her, and is encouraging others to get registered and vote so that we can have an immigration system that actually works, uniting families instead of separating them.
By the end of the day we'd registered and added hundreds of students to our network. One small step on just one day in February towards building the voting power we need to win in November.
That was yesterday.
[](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260218.7pWXgr&refcode=ema20260218-240694&t=3&akid=240694%2E444211%2EAePKKR)
[](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260218.7pWXgr&refcode=ema20260218-240694&t=4&akid=240694%2E444211%2EAePKKR)
[](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260218.7pWXgr&refcode=ema20260218-240694&t=5&akid=240694%2E444211%2EAePKKR)
[](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260218.7pWXgr&refcode=ema20260218-240694&t=6&akid=240694%2E444211%2EAePKKR)
Two days ago, we did the same thing at Midwestern State University in Wichita Falls. Meeting students, registering them, having great conversations about their community, their country, their dreams and the things that worry them most. We talked about ICE, we talked about the impunity of the rich and powerful in this country, exemplified in the failure to prosecute those responsible for abusing and trafficking children with Jeffrey Epstein. And we talked about how voting is the most powerful tool we have to change the status quo in this country.
[](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260218.7pWXgr&refcode=ema20260218-240694&t=7&akid=240694%2E444211%2EAePKKR)
We had a big town hall last night for the MSU students and everyone else in Wichita County. A lot of folks showed up, asked great questions, made strong points, got us all thinking about our chance to save America at its moment of truth. We left Wichita Falls for the two-hour drive to Dallas determined to make the most of it.
[](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260218.7pWXgr&refcode=ema20260218-240694&t=8&akid=240694%2E444211%2EAePKKR)
Today I'll be doing this at the University of Texas at Arlington. Thursday we'll be at University of Texas at Dallas. And Friday at Texas Woman's University.
We do it because it works. Statewide young people turned out at a rate of 37% in 2024. Those in our program turned out at over 79%. Now we need to grow it as big as we can get it. One county, one university, one person at a time, we are changing the odds for Democrats in November.
Thank you,
Beto

Peter,

Tariffs are taxes. And right now, American families and small businesses are paying the price for Trump's tariff war.

These tariffs are driving up costs, straining relationships with our allies abroad, and making it harder for small businesses to survive. Families are feeling it at the checkout line, business owners are feeling it when they order supplies, and farmers and manufacturers are feeling it when markets close.

But instead of allowing Congress to do its job and provide oversight, **Speaker Mike Johnson tried to pressure his Republican colleagues into protecting Trump's agenda. He called a vote on the House floor for members of Congress to give up their oversight authority over Trump's tariffs. This would've meant Trump could continue his tariff wars without any means of being stopped and held accountable.**

_Think about that, Peter._

The Constitution gives Congress authority over trade and taxes, which means oversight isn't optional—it's essential. But instead of standing up for that responsibility, Republican leadership tried to step aside and let this administration act without accountability, while Democrats stood strong and voted **NO.** Thankfully, this resolution failed, but it won't be the last time Mike Johnson uses his speakership to try to cede more power to Donald Trump.

Kim believes deeply that no administration—Republican or Democrat—should operate without checks and balances. When policies are costing Americans thousands of dollars and hurting small businesses in our communities, Congress has a duty to step in.

[**Kim will always stand up to an administration that's gone too far. But to truly protect oversight and hold the line on behalf of working families, we need a blue Congress willing to keep the pressure on. The 988 Lifeline has already helped nearly 1.6 million young people across the country. But right now, LGBTQ+ youth face an especially high risk of suicide — a crisis that must be addressed head-on.
So many of these young people are worried, scared, and searching for acceptance and understanding. But the Trump Administration — led by HHS Secretary RFK Jr. — has turned its back on these kids, eliminating a life-saving program for no reason at all.
For a kid in crisis, these services are life or death. Even some of my Republican colleagues agree. Now, it’s time for the Trump Administration to take the hint:

body:
Every single one of us can be sand in the gears of injustice.
#
It is important to remember that there are more of us than them.

| | Fellow Patriot,
---
| | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus.

He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness.

And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible.

I saw it up close -- _Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. _

But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything.

_**He started observing the Sabbath. **_

Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance.

_But as an act of obedience. _

As a way of saying, **_" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." _**

Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped.

He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield.

No email. No media. No work.

He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children.

It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much.

But over time, it changed him.

And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned...

Fellow Patriot, like I mentioned, this isn't a political book.

It's not a culture war manifesto.

It's a call to stop.

To rest. To breathe. To return to God.

**Because Charlie believed America hadn 't just forgotten truth... It had forgotten trust. **

Trust that the world keeps spinning when you step away.

Trust that God is in control.

Trust that rest is not weakness -- it's worship.

**In _Stop, in the Name of God,_ you'll discover: **

🔥 How Charlie reclaimed the Sabbath in a world built on burnout

🔥 What sacred rest gave back to him -- as a father, husband, and believer

🔥 Why he believed this message could spark revival in a restless generation

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AVEMR/1/81321/images/emergeemailheader.jpeg]
Dear Peter,
Thank you.
Because of your support, Emerge women are not just running for office—they are stepping into leadership and holding powerful people accountable once in office.
Right now, we’re seeing exactly why that matters.
As new details continue to emerge around Jeffrey Epstein and the individuals connected to him, there has been no shortage of deflection and denial from those in power. But Emerge alum and Congresswoman Melanie Stansbury is refusing to let the truth stay buried. She has traveled to review unredacted files herself and has been one of the clearest, strongest voices demanding accountability from those who have tried to obscure their ties.
At the same time, Congresswoman Becca Balint —another Emerge alum—is doing what too many in power won’t: asking the hard questions directly. When Attorney General Pam Bondi attempted to sidestep responsibility, Rep. Balint pushed back forcefully, calling out the refusal to investigate officials tied to Epstein and demanding answers on behalf of the American people.
This is what your investment makes possible.
Women who don’t back down.
Women who ask the questions others won’t.
Women who refuse to let power go unchecked.
At Emerge, we’ve always believed that when women lead, our government works better—more transparently, more accountably, and more in service of the people. Thanks to you, thousands of women have the training, network, and support to step into that role.
Your support doesn’t just help women run. It helps them lead with courage once they get there.
And in moments like this, that leadership makes all the difference.
Thank you for being part of this work—and for believing in the power of women to change our politics for the better.
With gratitude,
Sandra
P.S. We’re just getting started. With your continued support, we can train and elect even more women who are ready to speak truth to power and hold leaders accountable.

We just got a new poll back and I wanted you to be the first to know: We are in a dead heat with Greg Abbott — and victory is within reach. We are building a movement that can defeat Abbott this fall. = | = This is a huge moment for our campaign and we wouldn’t be here without you. Our race is this close because Texans are fed up with paying the price for Abbott's corruption. The Greg Abbott corruption tax is keeping Texans from being able to afford a home, get quality health care, and keep our neighborhood schools open. This poll proves how competitive this race really is, and it means that we can win this race in November and secure a Texas where families can thrive, not just survive. Right now, we're in the fight of our lives. Trump and his fossil fuel cronies are dismantling decades of climate progress, attacking our communities, and doing everything in their power to keep us from flipping the House blue this November.
**But here's what I know for certain: sustained grassroots power beats Big Oil's billions _every single time._**
Year after year, our candidates are up against the fossil fuel industry, dark-money super PACs, and corporate interests that would rather buy elections than let communities choose their own future.
We’ve helped elect over 200 climate and democracy champions since launching JanePAC because there’s a powerful movement behind us, including more than 1,800 monthly donors. Their steady support is the reason we can plan ahead, invest early in races other operatives write off, and respond immediately when our candidates face attacks from corporate polluters.
And when you join my Grassroots Cabinet, you'll be welcomed into a community with some meaningful perks:
✨ _**Direct updates** from me about the progress your investment is making possible_ ✨ _**Early access to events and exclusive discounts** on JanePAC merchandise_ ✨ _**Special invites to our quarterly debrief calls** where we pull back the curtain on our 2026 strategy, celebrate our wins, and hear directly from the climate champions you're helping elect_ ✨ _**And the chance to receive a personal call** from yours truly to say thank you_
---

Friend, Another day, and another inexplicable move by this White House that will wreak havoc on working families in Michigan. clean_body: Americans overwhelmingly reject the direction he's taking our country in. | = Peter, EMILYs List women will be essential to taking back the U.S. House in 2026 — and creating a check on the Trump administration, including Deputy Chief of Staff Stephen Miller. ******=**** | = Let's be clear about who we're up against: Stephen Miller has become one of the most influential figures in Trump's White House. He has drafted — or personally edited — executive orders the president has signed, and he's faced little internal resistance as he pushes an extreme agenda most Americans oppose. And we're seeing the consequences of Miller's pet projects in real time: attacks on immigrant communities, assaults on our fundamental freedoms, efforts to weaken democratic institutions, and rollbacks of protections that took generations to win. This is why we're investing in House races earlier and more aggressively than ever. We need a firewall in Congress strong enough to stop Trump, Stephen Miller, and the cruel agenda they're forcing upon our country. It starts with electing EMILYs List women who see the impact of these policies in their communities — and who will name what’s happening for what it is: a deliberate strategy to divide people and fuel fear. ****=****** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately: = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Thank you for standing with us, EMILYs List | = | | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- Thank you for being a supporter of EMILYs List. name: Chris Pappas
subject: I am *still* sorry about Karoline Leavitt
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
We already rejected MAGA talking points in New Hampshire. Now national Republicans are dusting off their playbook.
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=5174%2E582294%2EZNnBBN)
**I’m sorry about Karoline Leavitt.**
A few years ago, Karoline Leavitt ran against me for Congress here in New Hampshire. Her campaign was steeped in extreme MAGA rhetoric and zero connection to the actual issues Granite Staters face every day. **Voters saw right through it and rejected her agenda by nearly 10 points.**
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260218_2.5gU5PH&refcode=em20260218-2&t=2&akid=5174%2E582294%2EZNnBBN)
Unfortunately that race turned into a national audition. Now the same talking points and spin that New Hampshire voters dismissed are being used daily from the White House briefing room.
So if you’re wondering how the rest of the country ended up having to listen to Karoline Leavitt, it’s because New Hampshire proved something important first: Her extreme ideas don’t hold up when you put them in front of real voters.
But that hasn’t stopped the MAGA machine from trying. **National Republicans are pouring money into New Hampshire because they think they can break through and notch a win here to cling to their Senate majority.** They’ve lined up behind John Sununu, an NRSC-backed candidate who will vote with Donald Trump and MAGA leadership when it matters most. It’s a new candidate reading from the same old playbook.
I’ve beaten their playbook before by focusing on kitchen-table issues, standing up for families, and telling the truth. **[Now I need your help to do it again. Will you chip in $5 to help us keep this Senate seat blue and fight on what matters to Granite Staters?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260218_2.5gU5PH&refcode=em20260218-2&t=3&akid=5174%2E582294%2EZNnBBN)**
Granite Staters value independence. They reward common sense. And they don’t like being sold a script written somewhere else.
If you believe New Hampshire should keep leading the way and showing the rest of the country that MAGA politics don’t work here, I’m asking you to be a part of our campaign. **If Democrats are going to flip the Senate, we need to win this open race in New Hampshire.**
**[Will you chip in to help us keep this Senate seat blue and stop national Republicans from installing another vote for Trump’s agenda?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260218_2.5gU5PH&refcode=em20260218-2&t=4&akid=5174%2E582294%2EZNnBBN)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260218_2.5gU5PH&amount=5&refcode=em20260218-2&t=23&akid=5174%2E582294%2EZNnBBN)**
Thanks for being in this fight with me.
Chris
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_cp_footer?refcode=em20260218-2&t=24&refcode2=5174_582294_ZNnBBN&akid=5174%2E582294%2EZNnBBN)**
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with grassroots supporters like you. However, if you would like to change your subscription preferences, here are some options:
* [Receive Fewer Emails](https://act.chrispappas.org/signup/cps_receive_fewer_emails/?t=25&akid=5174%2E582294%2EZNnBBN)

| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Hi there,
Over the years, I’ve learned that trust isn’t something you demand in politics. It’s something you earn over time.
I’m grateful that more than 100 current and former elected officials across all of Colorado trust me to be our next State Treasurer.**And** **I’m especially proud that every federally or statewide elected leader in Colorado who has endorsed in this race has endorsed our campaign.**
I’m especially honored by the support of two people who have actually done this job:
“There is no better preparation for State Treasurer than Jeff’s service on the Joint Budget Committee, giving him a deep understanding of how to use Colorado’s dollars to expand opportunity and affordability.”**—Governor Roy Romer**
“I trust Jeff because he understands the numbers, but more importantly, he never forgets what those numbers mean for families across Colorado.”**—Treasurer Cary Kennedy**

When people who’ve held the office say you’re ready to lead it next, that matters.
---
[|
---](https://bridgesforcolorado.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba078768558df9fe7d8559d49&id=2203f954dd&e=b48bb2b4f4)
| | I’m also proud to have support from leaders across the entire state, including Secretary Ken Salazar and Members of Congress Joe Neguse, Jason Crow, Ed Perlmutter, Betsy Markey, and John Salazar. **From the Front Range to the San Luis Valley to the Eastern Plains and the Western Slope, this campaign has earned trust from every corner of Colorado.**
[You can see the full list of more than 100 endorsers online here.](https://bridgesforcolorado.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba078768558df9fe7d8559d49&id=01323fa8c4&e=b48bb2b4f4)
From my years on the Joint Budget Committee, I know our state’s finances inside and out, line by line, program by program. From my decade in the legislature, I know the local leaders and partners doing the work to make Colorado more affordable.
As Treasurer, I’ll use that experience to invest Colorado dollars in Colorado. In housing, infrastructure, and clean energy. Because where we invest reveals what we value.
I’m grateful to have the support of so many leaders across our state, and I’d be grateful to earn yours as well. If I can count on your vote at State Assembly in Pueblo on March 28th, please reply to this email. And of course, you can always text or call my personal cell at 303-358-5551.
---
| | Talk soon,
P.S. [When you let a 2-year-old choose his clothing, sometimes they end up looking like Winnie the Pooh.](https://bridgesforcolorado.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba078768558df9fe7d8559d49&id=4cd9ee0b2d&e=b48bb2b4f4) Might start keep the Halloween costume somewhere else...

body:
Trump is racist. And it shows up in policy.

| |
---
Team,

Donald Trump is a racist. That’s not an opinion. It’s a fact. He’s not even hiding it anymore. His latest racist post about the Obamas is exactly what we’ve seen for years: using racism for attention, spreading hate, normalizing cruelty, and trying to divide the country. And this doesn’t stop at words. Trump’s racism shows up in policy. You see it in the immigration system he’s built and weaponized. You see it in ICE operating without accountability, targeting communities, and hiding behind masks while violating people’s rights. We don’t need to overanalyze this. And we don’t need to soften the language. When racism drives policy, people get hurt. Let’s call it what it is. That’s why I’ve been clear: ICE should be abolished, those who violate the law should be prosecuted, and we need an immigration system that reflects American values. I’m running for the U.S. Senate because this country needs leaders who won’t tiptoe around racism, excuse it, or pretend it’s something else. **[If you’re ready for leadership that tells the truth and acts on it, chip in to help us confront this head-on.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125658686/602502298/2090747700?refcode=260218_sm_djt_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmOWIyNjI1Ny0xOTBkLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yd8kfDLbA2Oc-UVm1iogFINZ-wOnQTF-B_Hwm8NWnaI=)** | [CHIP IN](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125658687/602502299/1375639745?refcode=260218_sm_djt_b1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmOWIyNjI1Ny0xOTBkLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yd8kfDLbA2Oc-UVm1iogFINZ-wOnQTF-B_Hwm8NWnaI=)

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125658862/602503029/1206069681?refcode=em-2.18.26-all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYTJiZDZmYy0xOTBkLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KRZTMr9qVO7rMc0J4jkLg0O7bjyfANt8_ylpMJZR-ss=)
When I was growing up, salmon fishing in the summers and dog mushing in the winters, Alaska was a place of abundance.

I still love to be outside. It reminds me of being a kid.

But the abundance I remember doesn’t exist anymore. Now, all across Alaska, we have scarcity.

Multi-national companies are trawling our waters and decimating our fish stocks. The moose, caribou, and migratory birds that used to fill our freezers are harder to find.

So we buy more groceries, where the prices are just crushing Alaska families.

I’m tired of politicians in DC doing nothing to stop it. All while they profit off that very same system.

That’s why I’m running to fight for Alaska’s future. Systemic change is the only way to fill our homes with abundance again.

But it won’t be a smooth course to the finish line. We’re racing against corporate donors and dark money groups who are going to spend big because they don’t want the rigged system to change. They’re the only ones this broken system is working for!

_So here’s where the lessons I learned from dog mushing come in:_

**As long as we’re all pulling in the same direction, we can win this.**

It’s all about the team, and I know we have an amazing grassroots movement that can take this on. Thousands of people have already pitched in to help us win this seat because they want to unrig the system in DC.

Now, I’m hoping that today’s the day you can join them, because it all adds up when we chip in together.

So I’m asking:

**[Split a donation of $10, or whatever you can, between my campaign and George Whitesides to help us build on our grassroots momentum. clean_body: | = In a moment, I’m going to ask you to = But first, let me explain why your support is so important using one of my favorite Alaska winter activities – and our official state sport! = When I was growing up, salmon fishing in the summers and dog mushing in the winters, Alaska was a place of abundance. I still love to be outside. It reminds me of being a kid. But the abundance I remember doesn’t exist anymore. Now, all across Alaska, we have scarcity. Multi-national companies are trawling our waters and decimating our fish stocks. The moose, caribou, and migratory birds that used to fill our freezers are harder to find. So we buy more groceries, where the prices are just crushing Alaska families. I’m tired of politicians in DC doing nothing to stop it. All while they profit off that very same system. That’s why I’m running to fight for Alaska’s future. Systemic change is the only way to fill our homes with abundance again. But it won’t be a smooth course to the finish line. We’re racing against corporate donors and dark money groups who are going to spend big because they don’t want the rigged system to change. They’re the only ones this broken system is working for! So here’s where the lessons I learned from dog mushing come in: As long as we’re all pulling in the same direction, we can win this. It’s all about the team, and I know we have an amazing grassroots movement that can take this on. Thousands of people have already pitched in to help us win this seat because they want to unrig the system in DC. Now, I’m hoping that today’s the day you can join them, because it all adds up when we chip in together. So I’m asking: = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | **= | = ---|--- = | = = | =** This team can’t run without your support! Thank you for hearing me out. Let’s go! Mary | = = = George has spent his career solving problems. Geneva Talks End, Both Sides Dig In

Two days of U.S.-brokered peace talks between Russia and Ukraine [wrapped up Wednesday](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkL1uhDAQhJ_GdIfsPX4LF2noLm1KtF6vwYqxEfZBHj8ib5Buim9mpO_rNb_QBx-XT9xY0-lnm-x8YiTeEn1nTJRPf2BY0DmeQUL3kPBQwxzDrCqryXZPqFirvldN2zYA1apZqs6MRNKYcURDsiM3Gicd0TAMdqi8vpckqAGg7aWqwdkeWzSuYTs2yohGvneLhXNNKWY-Tiz-ZB9julOKNaWtCnotZc_i-SFgEjBd11VfmFcfl5Ii_-DmIx83KmDKTHdRwBT5yje9-sKPNb0zC5iqQ9v98iH43PWikcuGPvy9lP97OTX8BgAA__--YHQj) in Geneva, with both sides calling the negotiations "difficult." President Zelensky said Ukrainian forces are now ready to [monitor a ceasefire](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkLGO4yAURb_G7rDgBcdOQbGNu2y7pfUCDwftAyzA9nz-KPMH093mHh2df8_1iYFD2v5iJGPPsLrs1hOTpZjt_4rZ1jMU5A29pxUk3IUEoeY18ap6Z6y736Ano6ZJ6XHUAP3bSOsU2JEeSo9oSSvvtbQ0Oz97h576YD4kCWoGGCepBvBuwhFfXpN7aPXqtDx2h43qYHOqVE5s4aSQUv6snAabY8_m3dpeu9ufDpYOluu6Bp-_El2fW-xg2TOHFmztYAkFk6hhS8hVpMMyYRF7yVuhWsVGiU4UrRxxFxaZq_AHs3ChRkyNKVJqfTFuvwJzqPep03KLGPjHpP2-3WngOwAA___zGYMJ) if the political will exists. The sticking point remains territory — Moscow is demanding all of eastern Ukraine's Donbas region, a non-starter for Kyiv. Meanwhile, envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner juggled both the Russia-Ukraine and Iran nuclear talks in the same day, underscoring the administration's aggressive diplomatic pace. ★★★

U.S. Drops Bombshell on China's Secret Nuke Test

The State Department released seismic evidence Tuesday supporting its explosive claim that China secretly conducted an [underground nuclear test](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkLGOpDAQRL8GMiO7MWMucHAJ2Vx6IWrsNtNaYyPsgf38FZttuFmppFcqvf_P-YkcOa3_cCPrTp599vOJydGW3UfB7MrJB8YVQ6AZJDyEBKHGOcVZtd46_-ihJauMUXoYNED7stppqVXv9DhqIyWB8aaXfdByWGAJ1LK9lySoEWAwUnUQvMEBl6DJ_9FqabR87x4rlc7lVOg4sfJJnFK-U06dy1sb7avWvTT93wamBqbrurqQPxNdN7Y1MO05cmVXGpjeRaS3i4SHqFQqp1V4WrCSOIjXxJWKwFDpEKXerae9CoyRVirCvTjhD749rN8vjpHLwzRarhty_H5Vf-_xtPAVAAD__yPghV4) in 2020 at the Lop Nur test site. Assistant Secretary Christopher Yeaw told a Hudson Institute event that a monitoring station in Kazakhstan detected a magnitude-2.75 event consistent with a nuclear blast — and said China likely used "decoupling" techniques to conceal the explosion. The alleged test occurred on June 22, 2020 — just seven days after the deadly [Galwan Valley clash](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyU0L_OnDAQBPCnMd2eYM_AUbi4hu5Ll0RKgxZ7DVb8B9k-UN4-unuDrxvpJ41G8_tr-SLnXdx-UGClT7eYZJaTouaQ9N9CSZfTZfIbWcsLtjhAi9A9luiXrjFKm-GODatuHDvZ9xKx2ZW1dzvJYdCtRDtZskP_mB4T33tmHOTQOPVuarF7IPZj293QmpF6Wq1kM8luFbJ9HYYql5tOsXA-qbqTXYzpnVK86RQar_ZajyLuT4GzwPm6rlsoHxM4cwQXBc6Rr_LGlL0ROJsUyRuo-RUOKFCZApicjgKr22BNYS07ew-F_hXQu4sEOkXz0pUNxJf2TBkqlwpkK2fYyF8UQXsqu8CZMjyf3a-fyf5psjLH5bx3ZRiFbLdAzn-G1-9ffSr8HwAA___rwJCh) that killed 20 Indian soldiers, with analysts suggesting the border crisis and COVID chaos provided Beijing the perfect cover. The revelation comes as President Trump pushes China to join the U.S. and Russia in [nuclear arms negotiations](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkL2O5CAQhJ8GZx5BG_8FBJc4m0svtHqgGbcOgwXYq337lecNNiup9FVJ37_n-kQOHN9_cSdjL15dcuuF0dKe7P-CyZaLM4Y3ek8rSBhaCa2a1hhW1Thj3dBBQ0aNo9J9rwGazWjwneusn9HBLAepbNepiVB6cJO3U8PmXpKgJoB-lOoB3o3Y48trcrNWL6HleTisVB42xUL5wsoXcYzpTik-bNqbYLZajyK6PwIWAUvdaOMQ7k7AcqTA9lvAwrFSjh8Mg4ClH2HQ89TWfO5He5xlo9LajSO28bSBMLc1E9abbbJxxxeHwGUYhZbvHflz0NTf67oM_AQAAP__O3Z6pg) following the expiration of New START earlier this month.

# Obama center turns uglier with massive mind-numbing text design
The Obama Presidential Center in Chicago, already slammed for its brutalist design, now features a colossal, hard-to-read text display from Barack Obama's 2015 Selma speech wrapping the museum tower, sparking widespread mockery and complaints of headaches and confusion as construction nears its June 2026 opening.

* **Design Criticism Escalates:** The $850 million center's tower now displays five-foot-tall letters from Obama's "You Are America" Selma quote, criticized as unreadable and "lorem ipsum"-like when viewed from certain angles.

* **Public Reactions Pour In:** Social media users report developing headaches after trying to read the fragmented text, with one calling it a "dyslexic nightmare" and others mocking it as narcissistic self-praise.
* **Architectural Comparisons Intensify:** Detractors liken the overall structure to a Klingon prison or Soviet-era brutalist monstrosity, arguing the new addition makes it even less appealing visually.

* **Opening Timeline Confirmed:** Despite ongoing backlash over aesthetics and delays from lawsuits and reviews, the center--managed by the Obama Foundation--remains on track to open in June 2026 on Chicago's South Side.

| Hi Peter,

It’s April McClain Delaney.

I’m running for reelection in a tough Democratic primary against billionaire David Trone, and I want to be honest with you about what that means.

This won’t be an easy race, and it certainly won’t be a cheap one. My opponent seems to believe he can buy his way back into Congress without doing the work of listening to everyday Marylanders or earning their trust.

I don’t believe that’s how representation should work.

This seat isn’t a vanity project. It’s not a line on a resume. It’s a responsibility to show up, to ask hard questions, and to hold powerful interests accountable even when it’s uncomfortable. A billionaire who benefits from the system as it exists is never going to be the one to seriously challenge it.

That’s not just bad for this district. It’s bad for Maryland. _**And it’s bad for our country.**_

I’m running a people-first campaign because I believe our democracy works best when it’s powered by working people, not by personal fortunes. I’m doing the work. I’m showing up. And I’m fighting for accountability in Washington because I don’t owe anything to anyone except the people I represent.

name: David Hogg
subject: Endorsement Alert: Julio Salinas for TX HD-41
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
A new generation of Texans is rising up.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260218-1&t=1&akid=3161%2E587540%2EQ-PX8P)
Peter, I’m excited to share our latest endorsement with you today:
**Leaders We Deserve is officially endorsing Julio Salinas for TX HD-41.**
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260218_1_salinas.Ih5kPC&refcode=em20260218-3161&t=2&akid=3161%2E587540%2EQ-PX8P)
**Julio is an inspiring young leader who represents the future of Texas.** As Democrats continue to gain ground in Texas, we have a real opportunity to elect bold, progressive Dems who can push the state forward and hold the line against MAGA extremism. But if we let “Democrats in name only” — like Julio’s opponent — continue to deceive voters to win in a blue district, we will lose the chance to flip Texas for Democrats in the future.
**[If you’re ready to help elect Julio and build power in Texas, please split a $5 contribution now to support his campaign and Leaders We Deserve.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260218_1_salinas.Ih5kPC&refcode=em20260218-3161&amount=5&t=3&akid=3161%2E587540%2EQ-PX8P)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260218_1_salinas.Ih5kPC&amount=5&refcode=em20260218-3161&t=22&akid=3161%2E587540%2EQ-PX8P)**
Julio was raised in the Rio Grande Valley. His father was the second youngest of nine siblings who traveled as migrant farmworkers from New York to California before eventually settling in the Valley. Drawn by the promise of opportunity, his dad earned an education, built a career in local journalism, bought a home, and provided a modest middle-class life. But today, it seems the RGV is falling behind.
Julio is running to rebuild community, restore opportunity, and put working families first. He is running to represent his neighbors, because he’s ready to fight for:
* Investments in education, so every child can succeed.
* Access to affordable healthcare and mental health services.
* Good jobs and strong labor protections, so hard work once again pays off.

**[Pitch in $5 now to back Julio’s campaign and help Leaders We Deserve elect more young progressive candidates in Texas and across the country.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260218_1_salinas.Ih5kPC&refcode=em20260218-3161&amount=5&t=23&akid=3161%2E587540%2EQ-PX8P)**
Peter, here’s why this race matters so much:
**Julio’s only opponent, Seby Haddad, is a Republican running as a Democrat.**
Seby is a former Republican McAllen City Commissioner and banking executive. Just last month, he attended a Tea Party meeting. He is close to Commissioner Rodolfo “Rudy” Castillo, who surrendered to federal authorities in October 2025 after being recorded talking about bribing Mexican police officers to illegally import goods.
**Let me be clear: HD-41 is a safe blue seat.** But if we’re not paying attention, a conservative “Democrat in name only” can easily walk right through the door, risking a future majority in Texas. We cannot afford to stop investing in Democrats in the Rio Grande Valley because it is an area critical to securing victories statewide. It also could be the reason that the Republican gerrymander in Texas backfires if voters there come back to Democrats. That can only happen if we give voters candidates they truly believe in and feel represented by.
Julio is refusing corporate PAC money — just like all of our LWD candidates. He is running to work for _the people._ But we know that means he can only win if the people boost his campaign with the real, tangible grassroots support that it needs.
I know we can win this fight and keep building power in Texas. This work will have generational impacts — but it will only happen if we invest in our future leaders.
**[We need you with us, Peter. Split a $5 contribution to power our work.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260218_1_salinas.Ih5kPC&refcode=em20260218-3161&amount=5&t=24&akid=3161%2E587540%2EQ-PX8P)**
Thank you for your support,
David Hogg

Joining me is Andy Holt. Sworn in by Governor Bill Lee as Tennessee's 39th Commissioner of Agriculture in October 2025. Before that, he served as Deputy Commissioner and Assistant Commissioner for the Business Development Division.
Holt and his wife, Ellie, along with their seven children live on their family farm outside of Dresden, Tenn. Although he is a first-generation farmer, Ellie's family has been farming in West Tennessee for four generations. The Holt's operation consists of beef, goat, and swine production, as well as custom straw and hay baling. They also host agritourism activities on their farm each fall.
For more about Andy visit https://www.tn.gov/agriculture/department/commissioner-staff-thedept_rd/andy-holt.html

Our movement is growing, and _The New York Times_ is taking notice:
[](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260218_2.49636S&amount=3&%3Brefcode=20260218-193&t=2&akid=193%2E12592%2EkAYcow)

With your help, **this amendment will put power back in the hands of the people.**
With so many other states primed to redraw congressional maps without voter approval, we must act _now_ to restore and protect fairness in our elections before the midterms.
[**If you want to level the playing field ahead of the 2026 midterms, will you chip in anything you can today?**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260218_2.49636S&amount=3&refcode=20260218-193&t=3&akid=193%2E12592%2EkAYcow)

I’m suing Trump yet again — for the 58th time — and here’s why:
The Department of Energy is terminating billions of dollars in congressionally-mandated clean energy and infrastructure funding, simply because the President doesn’t like it. (And neither do his Big Oil fossil fuel industry donors!)
This move is illegal, it threatens hundreds of thousands of union jobs, it practically guarantees higher energy prices, and it increases pollution that wreaks havoc on our public health. I won’t let it stand — but I need your help to keep holding Trump accountable to the law. Please contribute whatever you can to our efforts today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?amount=50]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?amount=50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?amount=50]
Look, when Congress directs that funds be spent in a certain way — as in this case, through the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law and the Inflation Reduction Act — federal agencies can’t just put them on the chopping block because they feel like it.
The administration can’t terminate funding to score political points or to punish states simply because they’re led by Democrats — which, to be clear, is exactly what they’re doing here.
If this administration continues to break the law, we'll continue to take it to court — period. California will not back down.

body:
#

Peter,
We were told that MAGA was for the working class. Remember that?
_But this is a government of, by, and for the ultra-rich. This is the Epstein Class ruling our country._
They are literally the elites they pretend to hate.
***
_Trump promised to fight for the working class._
Instead, he's closing rural clinics and hospitals to cut taxes for Elon Musk.
_He said he would put “America first.”_
Instead, we're doing war for oil and nation-building again, and threatening to conquer Greenland.
_He said he would “drain the swamp!”_
**Instead, this is the most corrupt Administration of all time, and _everyone knows it._**
***
And I really do mean everyone. Just recently, Marjorie Taylor Greene said: _“I think people are realizing it was all a lie... What MAGA is really serving in this administration, who they're serving, is their big donors.”_
Guys, this is Marjorie Taylor Greene.
She went on: _The big donors who are donating to the big ballroom, those are the people who get the special favors. They get the government contracts. They get the pardons._
**_Marjorie, welcome to the resistance!_**
***
Every day our wave grows taller and our tent grows bigger. All across Georgia, more and more people of every background and belief reject the cruelty and chaos and corruption.
And their banana republic ballot raid in Fulton County will only motivate voters to turn out with unstoppable and unprecedented strength.
_But we can’t get complacent._
We would be naive not to expect dirty tricks. Don’t forget: Trump tried to steal the presidency when he lost it the first time.
Peter, the best insurance against Trump and MAGA’s dirty tricks is _landslide margins of victory._
My team is preparing an unprecedented effort to get out the vote and defend voting rights.
But that work is not easy or cheap. We have to work relentlessly through Election Day, and we need the resources to reach every single voter.
I’m the ONLY Democratic Senator up for reelection in a state Trump won — that means I’m MAGA’s #1 target for defeat.
Help me beat them again, just like we did in 2021.
[**So please, if you just can’t stand what’s being done to our country... and if you’re ready to deliver a massive rebuke to Trump and all of MAGA... rush $5 to my reelection campaign today.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-feb26.GJoCgS&refcode=em260218-1-f-o&t=1&akid=1673%2E5691347%2EDvTLGY)
